text: A bird of prey so large and ferocious it dwarfs many dragons.  All beneath its mighty wings should fear the sky.
translation: 一種龐大而凶猛的猛禽，連許多巨龍在牠面前都顯得渺小。凡在牠強大雙翼之下的生靈，都應畏懼天空。

text: A blue-rumped person with the head and tail of a mandrill.
translation: 一名臀部呈藍色、具有山魈頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A brightly-colored person with the head of a cassowary.
translation: 一名體色鮮豔、具有鶴鴕頭部的人形生物。

text: A colorful lizard that spends its life hunting insects with its long tongue.  It moves slowly through the trees, spying the surroundings with its independently roving eyes.
translation: 一種色彩鮮豔的蜥蜴，一生都用長舌獵捕昆蟲。牠在樹間緩慢移動，以能各自轉動的雙眼觀察四周。

text: A colorful person with the head and shell of a moon snail.
translation: 一名體色鮮豔、具有月亮蝸牛頭部與外殼的人形生物。

text: A colorful person with the head and tail of a chameleon.
translation: 一名體色鮮豔、具有變色蜥頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A colorful person with the head and wings of a lorikeet.
translation: 一名體色鮮豔、具有吸蜜鸚鵡頭部與翅膀的人形生物。

text: A colorful person with the head and wings of a masked lovebird.
translation: 一名體色鮮豔、具有蒙面愛情鳥頭部與翅膀的人形生物。

text: A colorful person with the head and wings of a peach-faced lovebird.
translation: 一名體色鮮豔、具有桃面愛情鳥頭部與翅膀的人形生物。

text: A compact offspring of horse and donkey, bred to be a beast of burden.
translation: 一種由馬與驢雜交而成的精壯動物，被培育作為役畜。

text: A creature from the evil swamp.  It resembles a squat, wingless bird with powerful beak and legs.  Its blotchy skin is brightly colored.
translation: 一種來自邪惡沼澤的生物。牠像一隻矮胖、無翼的鳥，長有強勁的喙與雙腿。斑駁的皮膚色彩鮮豔。

text: A creature that crawls along the cavern ceiling with four long arms.  Its body is shaped as the head of a man with a mouth full of shark teeth.  It waits for its prey to pass below.
translation: 一種用四條長臂沿洞穴頂部爬行的生物。牠的身體形如人的頭顱，嘴裡長滿鯊魚般的牙齒。牠會等待獵物從下方經過。

text: A creature with the shape of a man, but with stalks for eyes, and a great shell on its back.
translation: 一種外形似人的生物，但眼睛長在眼柄上，背負巨大的殼。

text: A crested person with the head and wings of a cockatiel.
translation: 一名長有冠羽、具有玄鳳鸚鵡頭部與翅膀的人形生物。

text: A dangerous water monster known for attacking ships at sea.
translation: 一種以襲擊海上船隻聞名的危險水怪。

text: A dark green man with the distinct head of a toad.
translation: 一種通體深綠、長有鮮明蟾蜍頭部的人形生物。

text: A fearsome, long-toothed mouth the size of a man's head, flying on bat wings.  It is found in deep caves.
translation: 一張如人頭般大小、長滿長牙的駭人大嘴，靠蝙蝠翅膀飛行。牠棲息於深處的洞穴。

text: A feathered dinosaur person with a sharp claw on their second toe.
translation: 一名覆有羽毛的恐龍人，第二趾上長有利爪。

text: A feathered man with the wings and head of a bird.  It lives underground.
translation: 一種覆有羽毛的人形生物，長有鳥的翅膀與頭部。牠生活在地下。

text: A feathered person with a brightly-colored bill.
translation: 一名覆有羽毛、長有鮮豔鳥喙的人形生物。

text: A feathered person with the head and wings of a great horned owl.
translation: 一名覆有羽毛、具有大角鴞頭部與翅膀的人形生物。

text: A feathered person with the head and wings of an eagle.
translation: 一名覆有羽毛、具有鷹頭部與翅膀的人形生物。

text: A feathered person with the head of a puffin.
translation: 一名覆有羽毛、具有海鸚頭部的人形生物。

text: A feathered person with the head of an emu.
translation: 一名覆有羽毛、具有鴯鶓頭部的人形生物。

text: A fierce creature from the evil snowy wilds.  It has white fur and a piercing howl.
translation: 一種來自邪惡冰雪荒野的凶猛生物。牠覆有白毛，嚎叫聲尖銳刺耳。

text: A flightless bird person with a terrifying beak.
translation: 一名不會飛行、長有駭人鳥喙的鳥人。

text: A floating pod with eye-stalks.  It can spray poison and it gives off poison gas when punctured.
translation: 一種長有眼柄、漂浮在空中的囊狀生物。牠能噴射毒液，被刺破時還會釋放毒氣。

text: A fluffy, pudge-filled being, known for its warm heart and stumble bumblings.
translation: 一種毛茸茸、圓滾滾的生物，以熱心腸和笨拙踉蹌的模樣聞名。

text: A flying monster with stretched skin over its emaciated body.  It has the head of a jackal with needle-like horns protruding through its mane.
translation: 一種飛行怪物，乾瘦的身體上繃著皮膚。牠長有胡狼般的頭部，針狀的角從鬃毛間伸出。

text: A giant amphibian predator found underground near water.
translation: 一種棲息於地下水邊的巨大兩棲掠食動物。

text: A giant amphibian predator found underground.
translation: 一種棲息於地下的巨大兩棲掠食動物。

text: A giant bear-like creature found in the wildest parts of the world.  It has striking black and white fur.
translation: 一種棲息於世界最荒野地帶的巨大熊形生物。牠有醒目的黑白皮毛。

text: A giant creature with many eyes and arms to terrify the sea.
translation: 一種長有眾多眼睛與腕足、令人聞風喪膽的巨大海洋生物。

text: A giant dragon-like monster with seven biting heads.
translation: 一種巨大的龍形怪物，長有七顆能咬噬的頭。

text: A giant flying mammal found underground.
translation: 一種棲息於地下的巨大飛行哺乳動物。

text: A giant humanoid monster found stomping about in the evil plains.  Their low howls can be heard long before they are seen.
translation: 一種在邪惡平原上踏著沉重腳步遊蕩的巨型人形怪物。在看見牠們之前很久，就能聽到牠們低沉的嚎叫。

text: A giant humanoid monster with a single eye set in its forehead.
translation: 一種巨型人形怪物，額頭上只有一隻眼睛。

text: A giant humanoid monster with the head of a bull.
translation: 一種長有公牛頭部的巨型人形怪物。

text: A giant humanoid monster with two heads.
translation: 一種長有兩顆頭的巨型人形怪物。

text: A giant limbless dragon that lives in the sea.
translation: 一種生活在海中、沒有四肢的巨龍。

text: A giant marine mammal with a toothy jaw.
translation: 一種顎部長滿牙齒的巨大海洋哺乳動物。

text: A giant monster in the form of a leopard seal.
translation: 一隻外形如豹形海豹的巨大怪物。

text: A giant monster in the form of a walrus.
translation: 一隻外形如海象的巨大怪物。

text: A giant oceanic creature resembling a huge fish's head connected to a wide tail.
translation: 一種巨大的海洋生物，外形如一顆巨大的魚頭連著寬闊的尾巴。

text: A giant oceanic fish with rows and rows of razor-sharp pointed teeth.
translation: 一種巨大的海魚，長有一排又一排剃刀般鋒利的尖牙。

text: A giant, striped, oceanic fish known to devour anything in its path.
translation: 一種帶有條紋的巨大海魚，以吞噬所經之處的一切聞名。

text: A gigantic aquatic reptile with four flippers and a huge toothy mouth.
translation: 一種碩大的水生爬蟲，長有四隻鰭肢，巨嘴中長滿牙齒。

text: A gigantic armored quadrupedal dinosaur with a mighty tail club.  It is a herbivore and has four horns.
translation: 一種碩大的四足恐龍，覆有甲片，長有強勁的尾錘。牠以植物為食，長有四隻角。

text: A gigantic bipedal dinosaur with a ferocious biting jaw and short arms.  It is amphibious and has a sail and a horn.
translation: 一種碩大的雙足恐龍，顎部咬合凶猛，前肢短小。牠能在水陸活動，長有背帆與一隻角。

text: A gigantic bipedal dinosaur with a ferocious biting jaw and short arms.  It is amphibious and has a sail.
translation: 一種碩大的雙足恐龍，顎部咬合凶猛，前肢短小。牠能在水陸活動，長有背帆。

text: A gigantic bipedal dinosaur with a mighty jaw and very short arms with two claws.
translation: 一種碩大的雙足恐龍，顎部強勁，極短的前肢各長有兩隻爪。

text: A gigantic blue and orange bird.
translation: 一種體色藍橙相間的碩大鳥類。

text: A gigantic creature resembling a human, almost unparalleled in size.
translation: 一種外形似人的碩大生物，體型幾乎無可匹敵。

text: A gigantic digging creature found underground.
translation: 一種棲息於地下、善於挖掘的碩大生物。

text: A gigantic feline predator, similar to its cousins in all but size.  It can be found in the savage wilderness.
translation: 一種碩大的貓科掠食動物，除了體型之外，各方面都與近親相似。牠棲息於蠻荒之地。

text: A gigantic filter-feeding fish found in temperate oceans.
translation: 一種棲息於溫帶海洋的碩大濾食性魚類。

text: A gigantic filter-feeding fish found in tropical oceans.
translation: 一種棲息於熱帶海洋的碩大濾食性魚類。

text: A gigantic hairless mammal with a long neck and a small trunk.
translation: 一種碩大的無毛哺乳動物，長有長頸與短鼻。

text: A gigantic hairless mammal with a long trunk and two backward-curving tusks.
translation: 一種碩大的無毛哺乳動物，長有長鼻與兩根向後彎曲的獠牙。

text: A gigantic herbivorous quadrupedal dinosaur.  It has a broad bony head frill and three horns.
translation: 一種碩大的四足草食恐龍。牠長有寬大的骨質頭盾與三隻角。

text: A gigantic magic statue made of bronze and bent on mayhem.
translation: 一尊碩大的青銅魔法雕像，一心只想肆意破壞。

text: A gigantic monster in elephant form.
translation: 一種外形如象的碩大怪物。

text: A gigantic monster in the shape of a sperm whale.
translation: 一隻外形如抹香鯨的碩大怪物。

text: A gigantic monster in the shape of an orca.
translation: 一隻外形如逆戟鯨的碩大怪物。

text: A gigantic monster, once a dragon, now adapted to and polluted by the underground.  Its wings fall limp at its side.  Its face is full of incredibly long teeth.  Its eyes are large to penetrate the darkness.
translation: 一種碩大的怪物，曾經是龍，如今已適應地下環境，也遭其污染。雙翼無力地垂在身側，臉上長滿極長的牙齒。牠的眼睛碩大，足以看穿黑暗。

text: A gigantic reptilian creature.  It is magical and can breathe fire.  These monsters can live for thousands of years.
translation: 一種碩大的爬蟲生物。牠具有魔力，能夠噴火。這些怪物可以活上數千年。
一種棲息於地下的碩大齧齒動物。

text: A gigantic spotted cat.  It is possibly the fastest animal on land and is found in the savage wilds.
translation: 一種帶有斑點的碩大貓科動物。牠可能是陸地上速度最快的動物，棲息於蠻荒野地。

text: A gigantic spotted predator, dwarfing its small cousins.  It is found in the wild lands.
translation: 一種帶有斑點的碩大掠食動物，令體型較小的近親相形見絀。牠棲息於荒野。

text: A gigantic version of its tiny cousin, this long, slimy creature tunnels through the rocks deep underground.
translation: 這種修長黏滑的生物是其微小近親的碩大版本，會在地底深處的岩石中鑽出隧道。

text: A gigantic version of the feline predator.  Its giant prides can be found in the wildest, most savage parts of the world.
translation: 一種貓科掠食動物的碩大版本。牠們組成巨大的獅群，棲息於世界最原始、最蠻荒的地帶。

text: A gigantic woolly mammal with a long trunk and two tusk.
translation: 一種覆有厚毛的碩大哺乳動物，長有長鼻與兩根獠牙。

text: A great slug with the torso of a man.  It pulls itself across the ground with its hands for greater speed.
translation: 一種長有人的軀幹的巨大蛞蝓。牠用雙手拉動身體，以便更快地在地面前進。

text: A green person with the head and arms of a mantis.
translation: 一名通體綠色、具有螳螂頭部與前肢的人形生物。

text: A green person with the head of a green tree frog.
translation: 一名通體綠色、具有綠樹蛙頭部的人形生物。

text: A green person with the head of a kea.
translation: 一名通體綠色、具有啄羊鸚鵡頭部的人形生物。

text: A grey person with the head and tail of a gray langur.
translation: 一名通體灰色、具有灰葉猴頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A grey person with the head of a koala.
translation: 一名通體灰色、具有樹袋熊頭部的人形生物。

text: A hairy person with the head and tail of a chinchilla.
translation: 一名渾身多毛、具有毛絲鼠頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A heavily-built person with the two teeth and beak of a lystrosaurus.
translation: 一名體格粗壯、具有水龍獸兩顆牙齒與喙的人形生物。

text: A hideous monster that has the body of a giant mole-rat and the torso of a mole-rat man.   It is found deep underground.
translation: 一種醜惡的怪物，長有巨鼴鼠的身體與鼴鼠人的軀幹。牠棲息於地底深處。

text: A horned person with the head of a gazelle.
translation: 一名長有角、具有瞪羚頭部的人形生物。

text: A horned person with the head of a mountain goat.
translation: 一名長有角、具有雪羊頭部的人形生物。

text: A horned person with the head of a muskox.
translation: 一名長有角、具有麝牛頭部的人形生物。

text: A horned person with the head of an ibex.
translation: 一名長有角、具有羱羊頭部的人形生物。

text: A horse-like creature with a spiral horn growing from its forehead.
translation: 一種類似馬的生物，額頭上長著螺旋狀的角。

text: A huge ape found in the forest.  It lives in small groups eating plants.  The groups are lead by a large dominant male with a silver back.
translation: 一種棲息於森林的龐大猿類。牠們以小群生活，吃植物為生。每群由一隻體型龐大、背部銀白的優勢雄性領導。

text: A huge aquatic mammal with giant tusks and dense whiskers.  They are thick and blubbery and live almost exclusively on mussels.
translation: 一種龐大的水生哺乳動物，長有巨大的獠牙與濃密鬍鬚。牠們身軀厚實、脂肪豐富，幾乎只以貽貝為食。

text: A huge armored fish with powerful biting jaws.
translation: 一種覆有甲片的龐大魚類，顎部咬合強勁。

text: A huge beast in the form of a gila monster.
translation: 一隻外形如毒蜥的龐大野獸。

text: A huge bipedal dinosaur with a giant biting jaw and short arms.
translation: 一種龐大的雙足恐龍，長有巨大的咬合顎部與短小前肢。

text: A huge bipedal dinosaur with a giant biting jaw and short arms.  It has two small horns over its eyes.
translation: 一種龐大的雙足恐龍，長有巨大的咬合顎部與短小前肢。眼睛上方長有兩隻小角。

text: A huge bipedal herbivorous dinosaur with a prominent head crest and a beaked mouth.
translation: 一種龐大的雙足草食恐龍，長有顯眼頭冠與喙狀嘴。

text: A huge bipedal herbivorous dinosaur.  It has a beaked mouth and a hollow crest atop is head.
translation: 一種龐大的雙足草食恐龍。牠長有喙狀嘴，頭頂有中空的冠飾。

text: A huge bipedal herbivorous dinosaur.  It has two prominent thumb spikes and a beaked mouth.
translation: 一種龐大的雙足草食恐龍。牠長有兩根顯眼的拇指尖刺與喙狀嘴。

text: A huge bird monster with extremely long legs and neck.
translation: 一種龐大的鳥形怪物，腿與頸部極長。

text: A huge brown creature found in temperate woodland.  It is known for its ferocious attack, usually when it or its young are threatened.
translation: 一種棲息於溫帶林地的龐大棕色生物。牠以凶猛攻擊聞名，通常是在自己或幼獸受到威脅時發動。

text: A huge cave monster with hundreds of feet moving along the bottom of its long body.  In place of a head, it has an enormous toothy maw.
translation: 一種龐大的洞穴怪物，修長身軀的底部有數百隻腳不停移動。牠沒有頭，取而代之的是一張長滿牙齒的巨口。

text: A huge creature in the shape of a grasshopper.
translation: 一隻外形如蚱蜢的龐大生物。

text: A huge emaciated-looking bear with great drooping ears and many sharp teeth.  It is found deep underground.
translation: 一種外貌乾瘦的巨熊，長有巨大下垂的耳朵與眾多尖牙。牠棲息於地底深處。

text: A huge feathered bipedal dinosaur with three gigantic claws on each hand.  It is a herbivore with a beaked mouth.
translation: 一種龐大的有羽雙足恐龍，每隻前肢上長有三隻巨爪。牠以植物為食，長有喙狀嘴。

text: A huge filter-feeding fish with great wings.  They travel the oceans and are curious and friendly.
translation: 一種長有巨大翼狀鰭的龐大濾食魚類。牠們遨遊海洋，好奇而友善。

text: A huge fish covered with growths and spots it uses to hide on the sea bed.  It is not usually aggressive.
translation: 一種龐大的魚類，全身覆有突起與斑點，用來在海床上隱藏。牠通常不具攻擊性。

text: A huge ground sloth with a long tongue.
translation: 一種長有長舌的龐大地懶。

text: A huge hairless mammal with a forked horn.
translation: 一種龐大的無毛哺乳動物，長有分叉的角。

text: A huge hairless mammal with a great shovel-like mouth capped with two tusks.  It has a long trunk and two small upper tusks as well.
translation: 一種龐大的無毛哺乳動物，巨大的鏟狀嘴前端長有兩根獠牙。牠還有長鼻與兩根較小的上獠牙。

text: A huge herbivore with thick plated skin and powerful build.  It is known for the thick horns on the end of its nose.
translation: 一種龐大的草食動物，皮膚厚實如甲片，體格強壯。牠以鼻端粗厚的角聞名。

text: A huge herbivorous quadrupedal dinosaur with a long neck and sail along its neck.
translation: 一種龐大的四足草食恐龍，長頸上長有帆狀構造。

text: A huge herbivorous quadrupedal dinosaur.  It has a broad spiky head frill and three horns.
translation: 一種龐大的四足草食恐龍。牠長有寬大帶刺的頭盾與三隻角。
一種外形如河馬的龐大怪物。

text: A huge humanoid monster with coarse fur, large tusks and horns.
translation: 一種龐大的人形怪物，覆有粗毛，長有巨大的獠牙與角。
一種無法移動的龐大海綿。

text: A huge intelligent ape found in the tropical forests.  It is bright red and found living in the trees.
translation: 一種棲息於熱帶森林、聰明而龐大的猿類。牠的體色鮮紅，生活在樹上。

text: A huge leaf-eating mammal.  It has an extremely long neck.  Its skin has a distinctive brown and white pattern.
translation: 一種以樹葉為食的龐大哺乳動物。牠的頸部極長，皮膚上有鮮明的棕白花紋。

text: A huge mammal with a long trunk and two tusks.
translation: 一種龐大的哺乳動物，長有長鼻與兩根獠牙。

text: A huge monster boar with jagged tusks.
translation: 一種龐大的野豬怪物，長有參差尖利的獠牙。

text: A huge monster in the form of a bark scorpion.
translation: 一隻外形如樹皮蠍的龐大怪物。

text: A huge monster in the form of a bluejay.
translation: 一種外形如藍松鴉的龐大怪物。

text: A huge monster in the form of a bushmaster.
translation: 一隻外形如巨蝮的龐大怪物。

text: A huge monster in the form of a bushtit.
translation: 一隻外形如叢山雀的龐大怪物。

text: A huge monster in the form of a buzzard.
translation: 一隻外形如禿鷹的龐大怪物。

text: A huge monster in the form of a cardinal.

text: A huge, predatory reptile found in coastal marshes and river deltas.  It ambushes its prey at the shore and uses its great size to drag the victim under and drown them.
translation: 一種棲息於沿海沼澤與河口三角洲的龐大掠食爬蟲。牠在岸邊伏擊獵物，憑藉巨大的體型將受害者拖入水中淹死。

text: A huge, predatory reptile with pale, colorless scales and red eyes.  It lives in caves and ambushes its prey.
translation: 一種龐大的掠食爬蟲，鱗片蒼白無色，眼睛呈紅色。牠生活在洞穴中，埋伏獵物。

text: A huge, round, hairless river creature.  It is a plant-eating animal but has long tusks and can be aggressive and deadly if disturbed.
translation: 一種龐大、圓胖而無毛的河棲生物。牠雖然吃植物，卻長有長獠牙，受到驚擾時可能變得凶猛而致命。

text: A huge, striped predator.  It is found in almost any climate on a lone hunt for its prey.
translation: 一種身有條紋的龐大掠食動物。幾乎在任何氣候下，都能見到牠獨自獵食。

text: A humanoid creature with the head and belly of a panda.
translation: 一種具有大貓熊頭部與腹部的人形生物。

text: A humanoid creature with the head of a blind cave fish.  They live in colonies in watery regions far underground.

text: A humanoid made of mud which lives near water underground.
translation: 一種由泥巴構成的人形生物，生活在地下的水邊。

text: A humanoid monster found lurking far underground.  It feigns death, usually near water, until a victim passes by.  It then uses its long arms to drag its prey into the water to drown or strangle them.
translation: 一種潛伏於地底深處的人形怪物。牠通常在水邊裝死，等待受害者經過，然後用長臂將獵物拖入水中淹死或勒死。

translation: 一種具有駝鹿頭部與鹿角的人形生物。

translation: 一種具有螞蟻頭部與身軀的人形生物。

text: A humanoid with the head of a capybara.  It is fond of swimming.
translation: 一種長有水豚頭部的人形生物。牠喜歡游泳。

translation: 一種具有企鵝頭部、雙足與羽毛的人形生物。

translation: 一種具有鴨嘴獸頭部、尾巴與毒距的人形生物。

translation: 一種大型水蟒，長有人的軀幹與手臂。

translation: 一種棲息於溫帶森林、龐大而神秘的猿形生物。

text: A large ape which lives in the tropical forests.  It is quite intelligent and lives in large and complex social groups.
translation: 一種生活在熱帶森林的大型猿類。牠相當聰明，形成龐大而複雜的社會群體。

text: A large ape which lives in the tropical forests.  It lives in complex social groups of many members.  Though it is quite intelligent, it has been known for ferocious attacks.
translation: 一種生活在熱帶森林的大型猿類。牠們組成成員眾多、結構複雜的社會群體。雖然相當聰明，牠們也以凶猛攻擊聞名。

translation: 一種覆有白毛的大型猿形生物，棲息於冰雪荒野。

text: A large dinosaur person with a beaked mouth and a prominent head crest.
translation: 一名大型恐龍人，長有喙狀嘴與顯眼的頭冠。

text: A large dinosaur person with a fierce jaw and a strong flexible neck.
translation: 一名大型恐龍人，顎部強勁，頸部強壯而靈活。

text: A large dinosaur person with a fierce jaw and short arms.
translation: 一名大型恐龍人，顎部強勁，手臂短小。

text: A large dinosaur person with a fierce jaw, short arms, and small horns over their eyes.
translation: 一名大型恐龍人，顎部強勁、手臂短小，眼睛上方長有小角。

text: A large dinosaur person with a long neck that has a sail.
translation: 一名大型恐龍人，長頸上長有帆狀構造。

text: A large dinosaur person with a long neck.
translation: 一名長頸的大型恐龍人。

text: A large dinosaur person with a thick domed head.
translation: 一名頭部厚實且呈圓頂狀的大型恐龍人。

text: A large dinosaur person with an armored carapace.
translation: 一名覆有堅硬甲殼的大型恐龍人。

text: A large dinosaur person with fierce jaws, a horn and short arms.
translation: 一名大型恐龍人，顎部強勁、長有一隻角，手臂短小。

text: A large dinosaur person with plates along its back and a spiked tail.
translation: 一名大型恐龍人，背上排列著骨板，尾部長有尖刺。

text: A large dinosaur person with spines along its back, a spiked tail, and two menacing shoulder spikes.
translation: 一名大型恐龍人，背部與尾部長有尖刺，肩上還有兩根駭人的長刺。

text: A large dinosaur person with two parallel head crests and short arms.
translation: 一名大型恐龍人，頭上有兩道平行冠飾，手臂短小。

text: A large dog-like monster with a haunting howl.
translation: 一種類似犬的大型怪物，嚎叫聲令人毛骨悚然。

text: A large domestic animal with a long neck.  It has been bred for its valuable hair.
translation: 一種長頸的大型家畜。人們為了牠珍貴的毛而繁育牠。

text: A large domestic pack animal.  It has a long neck.  It is prized for its hair.
translation: 一種大型家養馱獸。牠長有長頸，因毛髮而受到珍視。

text: A large eel-like fish found in coastal waters.
translation: 一種棲息於沿海水域的大型鰻形魚類。

text: A large feathered bipedal dinosaur with a sharp scything claw on its second toe.
translation: 一種覆有羽毛的大型雙足恐龍，第二趾上長有鋒利的鐮刀狀爪。

text: A large feathered dinosaur person with a sharp claw on their second toe.
translation: 一名覆有羽毛的大型恐龍人，第二趾上長有利爪。

text: A large feline person with pronounced eye teeth protruding from their mouth.
translation: 一名大型貓科人形生物，突出的犬齒伸出口外。

text: A large feline with pronounced eye teeth protruding from its mouth.
translation: 一種大型貓科動物，突出的犬齒伸出口外。

text: A large ferocious predator found in grasslands.  It lives in groups of females and one male with a large mane.  They hunt together and are capable of felling extremely large prey.
translation: 一種棲息於草原的大型凶猛掠食動物。牠們成群生活，由多隻雌性與一隻長有濃密鬃毛的雄性組成。牠們合力狩獵，能撲倒體型極大的獵物。

text: A large fish found in coastal temperate waters.
translation: 一種棲息於溫帶沿海水域的大魚。

text: A large fish which scavenges along tropical and temperate coastal waters.
translation: 一種在熱帶與溫帶沿海水域食腐的大魚。

text: A large flightless bird person.  Moa women are twice the size of moa men.
translation: 一名不會飛行的大型鳥人。雌恐鳥人的體型是雄恐鳥人的兩倍。

text: A large flightless bird that runs through the savanna.  It has a long neck and legs.
translation: 一種在稀樹草原上奔跑的大型不會飛的鳥。牠有修長的頸部與雙腿。

text: A large flightless bird.  Females are more than twice as large as males.  They are primarily herbivorous.
translation: 一種大型不會飛的鳥。雌性的體型是雄性的兩倍以上。牠們主要以植物為食。

text: A large flightless bird.  It is very curious and has been known to follow other creatures.
translation: 一種大型不會飛的鳥。牠好奇心旺盛，會跟隨其他生物。

text: A large flying reptile person with a long neck and beak.
translation: 一名大型飛行爬蟲人，長有長頸與長喙。

text: A large flying reptile with a long neck and beak.  It can soar at amazing speeds.
translation: 一種長有長頸與長喙的大型飛行爬行動物。牠能以驚人的速度翱翔。

text: A large hairless mammal person with a forked horn.
translation: 一名大型無毛哺乳類人形生物，長有分叉的角。

text: A large hairless mammal person with a large shovel-like mouth and a trunk.
translation: 一名大型無毛哺乳類人形生物，長有寬大的鏟狀嘴與長鼻。

text: A large hooved animal found roaming wild in temperate forests.  The males have long antlers.
translation: 一種在溫帶森林中野外遊蕩的大型有蹄動物。雄性長有長長的鹿角。

text: A large hooved animal with curved horns and a thick brown coat.  It is known for its strong odor.
translation: 一種長有彎角、覆有厚實棕色毛皮的大型有蹄動物。牠以強烈的氣味聞名。

text: A large hooved, maned herbivore.  They can run swiftly and many are domesticated as steeds.
translation: 一種長有鬃毛的大型有蹄草食動物。牠們跑得很快，許多被馴養為坐騎。

text: A large humanoid monster from the wild tundra.  It has translucent skin, icicles for teeth, red glowing eyes and pointed ears.
translation: 一種來自荒野凍原的大型人形怪物。牠有半透明的皮膚、冰柱般的牙齒、泛紅光的眼睛與尖耳。
一種外形如無尾熊的大型怪物。

text: A large legless armor-plated person with the powerful biting jaws of a dunkleosteus.
translation: 一名體型龐大、無腿且覆有甲片、具有鄧氏魚強而有力的咬合顎部的人形生物。

text: A large legless reptile person with a long neck.
translation: 一名大型無腿爬蟲人，長有長頸。

text: A large legless reptile person with the elongated snouth of an ichthyosaurus.
translation: 一名體型龐大且無腿的爬蟲類、具有魚龍細長吻部的人形生物。

text: A large legless shark person with the bizarre tooth whorl of a helicoprion.
translation: 一名體型龐大且無腿的鯊魚類、具有旋齒鯊奇異的螺旋狀齒列的人形生物。

text: A large long-necked creature with a large hump on its sturdy body.  It has been domesticated to carry passengers and cargo but is nonetheless bad-tempered and will spit.
translation: 一種大型長頸生物，結實的身軀上有一個大駝峰。牠被馴養來載人與運貨，但脾氣依然暴躁，還會吐口水。

text: A large mammal person with a long trunk and two tusks.
translation: 一名大型哺乳類人形生物，長有長鼻與兩根獠牙。

text: A large mammal person with a shell.
translation: 一名背負硬殼的大型哺乳類人形生物。

text: A large mammal with great antlers and a large nose. It lives in temperate forests.
translation: 一種長有巨大鹿角與大鼻子的大型哺乳動物。牠棲息於溫帶森林。

text: A large mammalian herbivore living in cold climates.  It has large antlers and sought-after fur.
translation: 一種生活在寒冷氣候下的大型草食哺乳動物。牠有巨大的鹿角，毛皮十分搶手。

text: A large mammalian herbivore.  It has long fur and curving horns.  It can be found in the mountains.
translation: 一種大型草食哺乳動物。牠長有長毛與彎角。牠棲息於山地。

text: A large mammalian herbivore.  It is powerfully built and has long curved horns.
translation: 一種大型草食哺乳動物。牠體格強健，長有彎曲的長角。

text: A large mammalian herbivore.  They often bear large horns and the males are ill-tempered.  They are domesticated for milk and meat.
translation: 一種大型草食哺乳動物。牠們通常長有大角，雄性脾氣暴躁。人們馴養牠們以取得奶與肉。

text: A large mammalian person with a long head.
translation: 一名頭部狹長的大型哺乳類人形生物。

text: A large mongoose-like monster known for hunting people amongst other things.
translation: 一種類似獴的大型怪物，除了其他獵物，也以獵殺人類聞名。

text: A large monkey with blue face and rump.  It lives in large groups and often survives by destroying crops and stealing garbage.  The males are larger, with powerful jaws.
translation: 一種臉部與臀部呈藍色的大型猴類。牠們成大群生活，常靠破壞農作物與偷食垃圾維生。雄性的體型較大，顎部強健。

text: A large monster in the form of a barn owl.
translation: 一隻外形如倉鴞的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the form of a bobcat.
translation: 一隻外形如短尾貓的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the form of a capuchin.
translation: 一隻外形如捲尾猴的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the form of a cockatiel.
translation: 一隻外形如玄鳳鸚鵡的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the form of a desert tortoise.
translation: 一隻外形如沙漠陸龜的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the form of a jackal.
translation: 一隻外形如豺的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the form of a kingsnake.
translation: 一隻外形如皇帝蛇的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the form of a mandrill.
translation: 一隻外形如山魈的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the form of a moth.
translation: 一隻外形如飛蛾的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the form of a porcupine.
translation: 一隻外形如豪豬的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the form of a puffin.
translation: 一隻外形如海鸚的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the form of a rhesus macaque.
translation: 一隻外形如獼猴的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the form of a skunk.
translation: 一隻外形如臭鼬的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the form of a spider monkey.
translation: 一隻外形如蜘蛛猴的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the form of a stork.
translation: 一種外形如鸛的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the form of a swan.
translation: 一隻外形如天鵝的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the form of an adder.
translation: 一隻外形如蝰蛇的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the form of an osprey.
translation: 一隻外形如魚鷹的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the form of an otter.
translation: 一種外形如水獺的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the shape of a beetle.
translation: 一隻外形如甲蟲的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the shape of a chameleon.
translation: 一隻外形如變色蜥的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the shape of a chinchilla.
translation: 一隻外形如毛絲鼠的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the shape of a crab.
translation: 一隻外形如螃蟹的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the shape of a damselfly.
translation: 一隻外形如藍蜻蛉的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the shape of a dragonfly.
translation: 一隻外形如蜻蜓的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the shape of a firefly.
translation: 一隻外形如螢火蟲的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the shape of a fly.
translation: 一隻外形如蒼蠅的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the shape of a gecko.
translation: 一種外形如壁虎的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the shape of a green tree frog.
translation: 一隻外形如綠樹蛙的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the shape of a hare.
translation: 一隻外形如野兔的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the shape of a king cobra.
translation: 一隻外形如眼鏡王蛇的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the shape of a leech.
translation: 一隻外形如水蛭的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the shape of a loon.
translation: 一隻外形如潛鳥的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the shape of a lorikeet.
translation: 一隻外形如吸蜜鸚鵡的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the shape of a mantis.
translation: 一隻外形如螳螂的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the shape of a monarch butterfly.
translation: 一隻外形如帝王蝶的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the shape of a parakeet.
translation: 一隻外形如長尾鸚鵡的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the shape of a roach.
translation: 一種外形如蟑螂的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the shape of a skink.
translation: 一隻外形如彩舌蜥的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the shape of a stoat.
translation: 一隻外形如白鼬的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the shape of an anole.
translation: 一隻外形如安樂蜥的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the shape of an axolotl.
translation: 一隻外形如蠑螈的大型怪物。

text: A large monster in the shape of an echidna.
translation: 一隻外形如針鼴的大型怪物。

text: A large monster taking the shape of a black mamba.
translation: 一隻外形如黑曼巴蛇的大型怪物。

text: A large monster taking the shape of a flying squirrel.
translation: 一隻外形如鼯鼠的大型怪物。

text: A large monster taking the shape of a tick.
translation: 一隻外形如蜱蟲的大型怪物。

text: A large monster taking the shape of a weasel.
translation: 一隻外形如黃鼬的大型怪物。

text: A large monster the shape of a kakapo.
translation: 一隻外形如鴞鸚鵡的大型怪物。

text: A large monster the shape of an armadillo.  It has thick armor for skin.
translation: 一種外形如犰狳的大型怪物。牠的皮膚如厚重的鎧甲。

text: A large monster with a long nose and brown feathers.
translation: 一種長有長鼻與棕色羽毛的大型怪物。

text: A large monster with an enormous shell and immensely powerful jaw.
translation: 一種大型怪物，背負巨殼，顎部極其強勁。

text: A large monster with the shape of a hedgehog.
translation: 一隻外形如刺蝟的大型怪物。

text: A large monster with the shape of a red panda.
translation: 一隻外形如紅熊貓的大型怪物。

text: A large nocturnal bottom-dwelling fish.  It is sluggish in movement and found in near-tropical shores.
translation: 一種夜間活動、棲息於水底的大型魚類。牠行動遲緩，出沒於接近熱帶的海岸。

text: A large oceanic fish capable of great speed.
translation: 一種游速極快的大型海魚。

text: A large oceanic fish covered with bony plates.
translation: 一種全身覆有骨板的大型海魚。

text: A large oceanic fish.  It is flat, round and red.
translation: 一種大型海魚。牠的身體扁平、圓而呈紅色。

text: A large omnivorous predator found in temperate woodlands.  Mainly living on berries, it will also steal carcasses from other hunters.  Though normally a docile animal, it has been known to kill in a predatory attack.
translation: 一種棲息於溫帶林地的大型雜食掠食動物。牠主要吃漿果，也會偷取其他獵食者捕獲的屍體。牠通常性情溫順，但也曾發動捕食攻擊並造成死亡。

text: A large person with the head of a black bear.
translation: 一名體型龐大、具有黑熊頭部的人形生物。

text: A large person with the head of a grizzly bear.
translation: 一名體型龐大、具有灰熊頭部的人形生物。

text: A large person with the head of a hippo.
translation: 一名體型龐大、具有河馬頭部的人形生物。

text: A large person with the head of a polar bear.
translation: 一名體型龐大、具有北極熊頭部的人形生物。

text: A large person with the powerful jaws and tail of an anteosaurus.
translation: 一名體型龐大、具有安蒂歐獸強勁顎部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A large person with the prominent back sail and tail of a dimetrodon.
translation: 一名體型龐大、具有異齒龍顯眼背帆與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A large person with the trunk and ears of an elephant.
translation: 一名體型龐大、具有大象長鼻與耳朵的人形生物。

text: A large predatory amphibious mammal.  It is difficult to evade once in the water.
translation: 一種能在水陸活動的大型掠食哺乳動物。一旦進入水中，就很難躲過牠。

text: A large predatory flightless bird with a terrifying beak.
translation: 一種不會飛行的大型猛禽，長有駭人的鳥喙。

text: A large python with arms of a man.
translation: 一種長有人的手臂的大型蟒蛇。

text: A large quadruped with a mane circling its manlike face and hands at the end of its forelimbs.  It lives underground and is fond of raiding the supplies of cavern outposts.
translation: 一種大型四足動物，形似人類的臉周圍長著鬃毛，前肢末端長有手。牠生活在地下，喜歡掠奪洞穴前哨的補給。

text: A large quadruped with a prominent sail along its back.
translation: 一種大型四足動物，背上長有顯眼的帆狀構造。

text: A large quadruped with two teeth and a beak for eating plants.
translation: 一種大型四足動物，長有兩顆牙齒與用來吃植物的喙。

text: A large reptile person with the shell of a turtle.
translation: 一名背負龜殼的大型爬蟲人。

text: A large reptile with a thick ridged shell.  It has been known to consume snakes and smaller turtles, and its bite can amputate fingers.
translation: 一種背負厚重稜脊甲殼的大型爬行動物。牠會吞食蛇與較小的龜，咬合力足以咬斷手指。

text: A large river monster, known for building huge wooden fortresses.
translation: 一種大型河中怪物，以建造巨大的木製堡壘聞名。

text: A large rodent that lives in groups in the high mountains.
translation: 一種群居於高山的大型齧齒動物。

text: A large shark with a strikingly bizarre tooth whorl for biting prey.
translation: 一種大型鯊魚，具有異常奇特的螺旋狀齒列，用來咬住獵物。

text: A large sloth person with a long tongue.
translation: 一名長有長舌的大型樹懶人。

text: A large slug-like creature with the torso of a man.  Its face is a mockery of teeth and slime.
translation: 一種長有人類軀幹的大型蛞蝓狀生物。牠的臉是牙齒與黏液構成的扭曲怪相。

text: A large solitary feline.  It is found most often in dense vegetation, ambushing its prey.
translation: 一種獨居的大型貓科動物。牠多出沒於茂密植被之中，伏擊獵物。

text: A large spotted feline found in grass and woodland.  It is known for great speed in hunting.
translation: 一種棲息於草地與林地、帶斑點的大型貓科動物。牠以狩獵時的高速聞名。

text: A large spotted feline predator.  It is capable of incredible speed when ambushing its prey.
translation: 一種帶斑點的大型貓科掠食動物。牠伏擊獵物時能爆發出驚人的速度。

text: A large underground monster with eight legs and sharp, venomous fangs.
translation: 一種大型地下怪物，長有八條腿與鋒利的毒牙。

text: A large white snake with the arms and torso of a man.  These creatures are evil and live far underground.
translation: 一條長有人類雙臂與軀幹的大型白蛇。這些生物邪惡而且生活在地下深處。

text: A large woolly mammal person with two horns.
translation: 一名渾身覆有厚毛的大型哺乳類人形生物，長有兩隻角。

text: A large, aggressive, oceanic fish with a mouth full of pointed teeth.  It is capable of great speed.
translation: 一種大型、好鬥的海魚，嘴裡長滿尖牙。牠能游得非常快。

text: A large, big-mouthed fish, found around coral reefs.
translation: 一種出沒於珊瑚礁周圍的大型闊嘴魚。

text: A large, dangerous fish found hunting in packs in any ocean.
translation: 一種危險的大魚，在各大海洋中成群獵食。

text: A large, dangerous fish, often found hunting solitarily along coastlines.
translation: 一種危險的大魚，常沿著海岸獨自獵食。

text: A large, flat, camouflaged fish found on the sea floor in temperate waters.  It is quite passive.
translation: 一種棲息於溫帶海域海底的大型扁平魚類，具有保護色。牠相當溫馴。

text: A large, flat, oceanic fish.  It dwells on the sea floor, both its eyes on the top side.
translation: 一種大型扁平海魚。牠棲息於海底，兩隻眼睛都長在身體朝上的一側。

text: A large, four-armed ape creature with three eyes and razor-sharp teeth.
translation: 一種大型四臂猿形生物，長有三隻眼睛與剃刀般鋒利的牙齒。

text: A large, long fish with many sharp fangs.  It hunts by ambushing its prey.
translation: 一種身體細長的大型魚類，長有許多銳利的長牙。牠靠伏擊獵物狩獵。

text: A large, long-bodied grazer with a thick mane that feeds on the tops of towercap mushrooms deep under the earth.
translation: 一種身軀修長、鬃毛濃密的大型食草動物，以地底深處塔帽菇的頂部為食。

text: A large, long-necked creature with two fleshy humps on its back.  It is domesticated to carry passengers and cargo.
translation: 一種大型長頸生物，背上有兩個肉質駝峰。牠被馴養來載人與運貨。

text: A large, muscular, spotted feline found in tropical jungles.  It is solitary and stalks and ambushes its prey.
translation: 一種棲息於熱帶叢林、體格強健且帶斑點的大型貓科動物。牠獨居，會潛行追蹤並伏擊獵物。

text: A large, pale rodent with loose, hanging, hairless skin.  It has long teeth and an incredibly powerful bite.  It is found underground.
translation: 一種蒼白的大型囓齒動物，無毛的皮膚鬆垂。牠長有長牙，咬合力極為強大。牠生活在地下。
一種大型掠食性海洋哺乳動物。

text: A large, round, lowland rodent.  It lives in burrows in the ground and ventures out to eat.
translation: 一種棲息於低地、體型大而圓胖的囓齒動物。牠住在地洞裡，會出洞覓食。

text: A large, strongly built quadruped with a tail.  It is a terrestrial herbivore.
translation: 一種體格強健、長有尾巴的大型四足動物。牠是陸生草食動物。

text: A large, strongly-built person with a tail.
translation: 一名體型龐大、體格強健且長有尾巴的人形生物。

text: A large, terrifying monster the shape of a wolverine.
translation: 一隻外形如狼獾的龐大而駭人的怪物。

text: A legless person with the head and back flippers of a leopard seal.
translation: 一名沒有腿、具有豹形海豹頭部與後鰭肢的人形生物。

text: A legless person with the head and back flippers of a walrus.
translation: 一名沒有腿、具有海象頭部與後鰭肢的人形生物。

text: A legless person with the head and tail of a king cobra.
translation: 一名沒有腿、具有眼鏡王蛇頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A legless person with the head and tail of a kingsnake.
translation: 一名沒有腿、具有皇帝蛇頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A long-bodied person with the head and tail of a skink.
translation: 一名身軀修長、具有彩舌蜥頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A long-bodied person with the head of a stoat.
translation: 一名身軀修長、具有白鼬頭部的人形生物。

text: A long-eared person with the head and tail of a hare.
translation: 一名長有長耳、具有野兔頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A long-limbed person with the head and tail of a spider monkey.
translation: 一名四肢修長、具有蜘蛛猴頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A man-like creature with the tail of a fish instead of legs.
translation: 一種類似人的生物，以魚尾代替雙腿。

text: A man-shaped abomination made entirely of blood.  These cursed creatures are only found very near the underworld.
translation: 一種完全由鮮血構成的人形怪物。這些受詛咒的生物只出沒於極接近冥界之處。

text: A man-shaped creature made of iron.
translation: 一種由鐵構成的人形生物。

text: A man-shaped creature with the legs of a goat and the empty-eyed skull of a goat.
translation: 一種人形生物，長有山羊的腿，頭部是眼窩空洞的山羊頭骨。

text: A medium-sized animal living in grass and woodland.  It has a large snout with four sharp tusks.  It will aggressively defend itself.
translation: 一種棲息於草地與林地的中型動物。牠有大吻部與四根銳利獠牙。牠會凶猛地自衛。

text: A medium-sized ape found in the trees.  It is known for its loud calls.
translation: 一種棲息於樹上的中型猿類。牠以響亮的叫聲聞名。

text: A medium-sized beast, known for its tusks and powerful build.
translation: 一種以獠牙與強壯體格聞名的中型野獸。

text: A medium-sized creature dedicated to the ruthless protection of nature.
translation: 一種中型生物，為了保護自然不惜採取冷酷手段。

text: A medium-sized creature prone to great ambition.
translation: 一種容易懷抱遠大野心的中型生物。

text: A medium-sized creature that can be found hopping through the grassland.
translation: 一種在草原上跳躍的中型生物。

text: A medium-sized creature with the arms and torso on a man, but with the head and tail of a narwhal.
translation: 一種中型生物，長有人的手臂與軀幹，卻有獨角鯨的頭部與尾巴。

text: A medium-sized dog-like creature.  It is sly, and groups can be heard howling in the night.
translation: 一種形似犬的中型生物。牠很狡猾，夜裡能聽見牠們成群嚎叫。

text: A medium-sized domestic animal.  It has a distinctive snout and corkscrew tail.  It is thought by some to be intelligent.
translation: 一種中型家畜。牠有獨特的吻部與螺旋狀尾巴。有些人認為牠很聰明。

text: A medium-sized fish found around coasts and islands.  It is easy prey for predators.
translation: 一種出沒於海岸與島嶼周圍的中型魚類。牠很容易成為掠食者的獵物。

text: A medium-sized fish found in lakes and streams.  They are bottom-feeders and tend to gather in groups.
translation: 一種棲息於湖泊與溪流的中型魚類。牠們在水底覓食，常聚集成群。

text: A medium-sized fish found in shallow oceanic waters.
translation: 一種棲息於淺海的中型魚類。

text: A medium-sized fish found in tributaries and oceans.
translation: 一種棲息於河流支流與海洋的中型魚類。

text: A medium-sized fish which shelters in caves on the shallow sea floor.  It hunts for food in packs but is not aggressive.
translation: 一種在淺海海底洞穴中棲身的中型魚類。牠們成群獵食，但不好鬥。

text: A medium-sized fish with a long snout.  It is found in lakes and streams.
translation: 一種長有長吻的中型魚類。牠棲息於湖泊與溪流。

text: A medium-sized herbivore that lives in the high mountains, able to navigate the slopes despite its hooved feet.
translation: 一種生活在高山的中型草食動物，雖然長著蹄足，仍能在山坡上靈活行走。

text: A medium-sized herding animal.  It is known for its short horns and beard.
translation: 一種成群生活的中型動物。牠以短角與鬍鬚聞名。

text: A medium-sized herding animal.  It is prized for its thick wool coat.
translation: 一種成群生活的中型動物。牠厚實的羊毛備受珍視。

text: A medium-sized highly social mammalian carnivore.  It has a keen sense of smell.  It can be trained to obey commands.
translation: 一種高度群居的中型肉食哺乳動物。牠嗅覺敏銳，可以訓練牠服從命令。

text: A medium-sized hoofed forest creature that grows its antlers back each year.
translation: 一種中型有蹄森林生物，每年都會重新長出鹿角。

text: A medium-sized humanoid driven to cruelty by its evil nature.
translation: 一種中型人形生物，邪惡的天性使其殘酷無情。

text: A medium-sized humanoid with the horns and legs of a goat.
translation: 一種長有山羊角與山羊腿的中型人形生物。

text: A medium-sized mammal that lives in the trees.  It is known for its easy-going nature.
translation: 一種生活在樹上的中型哺乳動物。牠以悠閒的性情聞名。

text: A medium-sized mammal with a prehensile nose.  It lives in the tropical rainforest.
translation: 一種長有可抓握鼻子的中型哺乳動物。牠棲息於熱帶雨林。

text: A medium-sized mammalian predator.  It is known by the tell-tale tufts of hair on the tips of its ears.
translation: 一種中型掠食哺乳動物。牠耳尖上鮮明的簇毛是其特徵。

text: A medium-sized monkey found in woods and grassland.  It usually lives on roots and insects but can become a pest in civilized areas, roaming in large groups and begging for scraps.
translation: 一種棲息於樹林與草原的中型猴類。牠通常吃根與昆蟲，但在文明聚居地可能成為禍患，成大群遊蕩並乞討食物殘渣。

text: A medium-sized monster walking on two clawed legs.  It has two mouths on the ends of a pair of tentacles.  It uses its mouths to digest its victims with acid and rows of razor-like teeth.
translation: 一種以兩條帶爪的腿行走的中型怪物。牠一對觸手的末端各長一張嘴，利用口中的酸液與一排排剃刀般的牙齒消化受害者。

text: A medium-sized oceanic fish prized for its meat.
translation: 一種因肉質而受到珍視的中型海魚。

text: A medium-sized oceanic fish, often hunted for its meat.
translation: 一種常因肉質而被捕獵的中型海魚。

text: A medium-sized oceanic fish.  It is fork-tailed and sought after for its meat.
translation: 一種中型海魚。牠有分叉的尾巴，魚肉十分搶手。

text: A medium-sized pack predator found in the savanna.
translation: 一種棲息於莽原、成群獵食的中型掠食動物。

text: A medium-sized predatory fish found in lakes and streams.  It is known for its ferocious attacks and interlocking teeth.
translation: 一種棲息於湖泊與溪流的中型掠食魚類。牠以凶猛的攻擊與交錯咬合的牙齒聞名。

text: A medium-sized red fish that lives in the ocean and swims up a river to breed.
translation: 一種生活在海中的中型紅色魚類，會溯河繁殖。

text: A medium-sized reptile with a large shell.  It can retreat into its shell to escape predators.
translation: 一種背負大殼的中型爬行動物。牠能縮進殼中躲避掠食者。

text: A medium-sized reptile with a thick shell, which it can retreat into when threatened.  This creature can administer a painful bite.
translation: 一種背負厚殼的中型爬行動物，受威脅時能縮進殼內。被這種生物咬到會非常疼痛。

text: A medium-sized reptile.  They can be found foraging for food such as eggs or worms.  They are said to be the most intelligent of their kind.
translation: 一種中型爬行動物。牠們會四處尋找蛋或蠕蟲等食物。據說牠們是同類中最聰明的。

text: A medium-sized sea mammal with a long thin horn on its nose.  It uses this horn to communicate and break up ice.
translation: 一種鼻部長有細長角的中型海洋哺乳動物。牠用這根角溝通並破開冰塊。

text: A medium-sized semi-aquatic rodent.  It lives in large herds and barks when alarmed.
translation: 一種半水生的中型囓齒動物。牠們成大群生活，受驚時會吠叫。

text: A medium-sized snake that lives in the trees.  It eats prey much larger than itself and slays them by crushing them to death.
translation: 一種棲息於樹上的中型蛇。牠能吞下比自己大得多的獵物，並將獵物纏繞勒死。

text: A medium-sized spotted fish found in temperate lakes and rivers.
translation: 一種棲息於溫帶湖泊與河流、帶有斑點的中型魚類。

text: A medium-sized spotted fish found in temperate rivers and lakes.
translation: 一種棲息於溫帶河流與湖泊、帶有斑點的中型魚類。

text: A medium-sized underwater mollusk with eight arms.  It is the most clever of its kind.
translation: 一種長有八條腕足的中型水生軟體動物。牠是同類中最聰明的。

text: A medium-sized, aggressive, territorial fish.  It can be found in shallow oceanic waters, and has also been known to travel up large rivers.
translation: 一種好鬥、領域性強的中型魚類。牠出沒於淺海，也會溯游進入大河。

text: A medium-sized, brown, snake-like fish found in ocean waters.
translation: 一種棲息於海中的中型棕色蛇形魚類。

text: A medium-sized, flat fish.  It lives near the beach and will defend itself with sharp barbs.
translation: 一種中型扁平魚類。牠生活在海灘附近，會用銳利的倒刺自衛。
一種中型、扁平的底棲魚類。

text: A medium-sized, green fish found in temperate lakes.
translation: 一種棲息於溫帶湖泊的中型綠色魚類。

text: A medium-sized, hooved herbivore.  Some are domesticated as beasts of burden.
translation: 一種中型有蹄草食動物。有些被馴養為馱獸。

text: A medium-sized, red-faced black bird that searches the temperate lands for carrion.
translation: 一種紅臉黑羽的中型鳥類，在溫帶地區搜尋腐肉。

text: A medium-sized, walking red panda with arms and a tail.  It prefers the forest and its beloved trees.
translation: 一種能行走、長有雙臂與尾巴的中型小貓熊。牠喜歡森林與牠鍾愛的樹木。

text: A medium-sized, winged fish found in the muddy coasts of both temperate and tropical waters.
translation: 一種長有翼狀鰭的中型魚類，棲息於溫帶及熱帶水域的泥濘海岸。

text: A monster in the shape of a woman with a bird's wings in place of arms and talons for feet.
translation: 一種外形如女人的怪物，以鳥翼代替手臂、以利爪代替雙足。

text: A monster many times the size of an ordinary kea.
translation: 一種體型數倍於普通啄羊鸚鵡的怪物。

text: A muscular person with the head of a wombat.
translation: 一名肌肉發達、具有袋熊頭部的人形生物。

text: A person in the form of a large black mamba with arms.
translation: 一名外形如大型黑曼巴蛇、長有手臂的人形生物。

text: A person in the form of a sponge with arms and legs.
translation: 一名外形如海綿、長有手臂與腿的人形生物。

text: A person resembling a large rattlesnake with arms.
translation: 一名外形如大型響尾蛇、長有手臂的人形生物。

text: A person with a cuttlefish in place of a head.
translation: 一名以烏賊代替頭部的人形生物。

text: A person with a large shell and the head of a giant tortoise.
translation: 一名背負大型硬殼、長有巨龜頭部的人形生物。

text: A person with an octopus in place of a head.
translation: 一名以章魚代替頭部的人形生物。

text: A person with the arms and wings of a barn owl.
translation: 一名具有倉鴞前肢與翅膀的人形生物。

text: A person with the carapace and head of a beetle.
translation: 一名具有甲蟲甲殼與頭部的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and arms of a brown recluse spider.
translation: 一名具有棕色遁蛛頭部與前肢的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and arms of a jumping spider.
translation: 一名具有跳蛛頭部與前肢的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and claws of a sloth bear.
translation: 一名具有懶熊頭部與利爪的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and feathers of a kiwi.
translation: 一名具有鷸鴕頭部與羽毛的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and fingers of a gecko.
translation: 一名長有壁虎頭部與指趾的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and fingers of an aye-aye.
translation: 一名具有指猴頭部與手指的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and flat tail of a beaver.
translation: 一名具有海狸頭部與扁平尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and flippers of a harp seal.
translation: 一名具有豎琴海豹頭部與鰭肢的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and flippers of an elephant seal.
translation: 一名具有象海豹頭部與鰭肢的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and fur of a groundhog.
translation: 一名具有土撥鼠頭部與皮毛的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and fur of a hamster.
translation: 一名具有倉鼠頭部與皮毛的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and fur of a hoary marmot.
translation: 一名具有花白旱獺頭部與皮毛的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and horns of a rhinoceros.
translation: 一名具有犀牛頭部與角的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and hump of a one-humped camel.
translation: 一名具有單峰駱駝頭部與背峰的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and humps of a two-humped camel.
translation: 一名具有雙峰駱駝頭部與背峰的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and legs of a grasshopper.
translation: 一名具有蚱蜢頭部與腿的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and legs of a louse.
translation: 一名具有蝨子頭部與腿的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and legs of a tick.
translation: 一名具有蜱蟲頭部與腿的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and markings of a hyena.
translation: 一名具有鬣狗頭部與體表斑紋的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and neck of a giraffe.
translation: 一名具有長頸鹿頭部與頸部的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and pincers of a crab.
translation: 一名具有螃蟹頭部與螯的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and powerful legs of a kangaroo.
translation: 一名具有袋鼠頭部與強壯腿部的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and quills of a porcupine.
translation: 一名具有豪豬頭部與棘刺的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and scales of a pangolin.
translation: 一名具有穿山甲頭部與鱗片的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and shell of a pond turtle.
translation: 一名具有池龜頭部與外殼的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and short tail of a bobcat.
translation: 一名具有短尾貓頭部與短尾的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and spines of a hedgehog.
translation: 一名具有刺蝟頭部與尖刺的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and tail of a capuchin.
translation: 一名具有捲尾猴頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and tail of a coati.
translation: 一名具有長鼻浣熊頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and tail of a cougar.
translation: 一名具有美洲獅頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and tail of a coyote.
translation: 一名具有郊狼頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and tail of a fox.
translation: 一名具有狐狸頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and tail of a gray squirrel.
translation: 一名具有灰松鼠頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and tail of a jackal.
translation: 一名具有豺頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and tail of a lizard.
translation: 一名具有蜥蜴頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and tail of a lynx.
translation: 一名具有猞猁頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and tail of a mink.
translation: 一名具有水貂頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and tail of a monitor lizard.
translation: 一名具有巨蜥頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and tail of a rat.
translation: 一名具有老鼠頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and tail of a red squirrel.
translation: 一名具有紅松鼠頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and tail of a rhesus macaque.
translation: 一名具有獼猴頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and tail of a saltwater crocodile.
translation: 一名具有鹹水鱷頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and tail of a weasel.
translation: 一名具有黃鼬頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and tail of a wolf.
translation: 一名具有狼頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and tail of a wolverine.
translation: 一名具有狼獾頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and tail of an aardvark.
translation: 一名具有土豚頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and tail of an alligator.
translation: 一名具有短吻鱷頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and tail of an anole.
translation: 一名具有安樂蜥頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and tail of an axolotl.
translation: 一名具有蠑螈頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and tail of an iguana.
translation: 一名具有鬣蜥頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and wings of a magpie.

text: A person with the head and wings of a red-winged blackbird.

text: A person with the head and wings of a sparrow.
translation: 一名具有麻雀頭部與翅膀的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and wings of a stork, also standing on long legs.
translation: 一名長有鸛的頭部與翅膀、以長腿站立的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and wings of a swan.
translation: 一名具有天鵝頭部與翅膀的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and wings of a thrips.
translation: 一名具有薊馬頭部與翅膀的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and wings of a vulture.
translation: 一名具有禿鷲頭部與翅膀的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and wings of a wren.
translation: 一名具有鷦鷯頭部與翅膀的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and wings of an albatross.
translation: 一名具有信天翁頭部與翅膀的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and wings of an oriole.
translation: 一名具有黃鸝頭部與翅膀的人形生物。

text: A person with the head and wings of an osprey.
translation: 一名具有魚鷹頭部與翅膀的人形生物。

text: A person with the head of a deer.
translation: 一名具有鹿頭部的人形生物。

text: A person with the head of a dingo.
translation: 一名具有野狗頭部的人形生物。

text: A person with the head of a lion.
