text: A person with the head of a sloth.
translation: 一名具有樹懶頭部的人形生物。

text: A person with the head of a tapir.
translation: 一名具有貘頭部的人形生物。

text: A person with the head of a warthog.
translation: 一名具有疣豬頭部的人形生物。

text: A person with the head of a wild boar.
translation: 一名具有野豬頭部的人形生物。

text: A person with the head of an elk.
translation: 一名具有麋鹿頭部的人形生物。

text: A person with the head, pincers and tail of a bark scorpion.
translation: 一名具有樹皮蠍頭部、螯與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the head, shell, and tail of a horseshoe crab.
translation: 一名具有馬蹄蟹頭部、外殼與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the hide and head of an armadillo.
translation: 一名具有犰狳皮膚與頭部的人形生物。

text: A person with the long body and head of an otter.
translation: 一名具有水獺修長身軀與頭部的人形生物。

text: A person with the mask and tail of a raccoon.
translation: 一名具有浣熊面部花紋與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A person with the shell and head of a snapping turtle.
translation: 一名具有鱷龜外殼與頭部的人形生物。

text: A person with the shell and tentacles of a nautilus.
translation: 一名具有鸚鵡螺外殼與觸手的人形生物。

text: A person with the wings and head of a damselfly.
translation: 一名具有藍蜻蛉翅膀與頭部的人形生物。

text: A person with the wings and head of a dragonfly.
translation: 一名具有蜻蜓翅膀與頭部的人形生物。

text: A person with the wings and head of a firefly.
translation: 一名具有螢火蟲翅膀與頭部的人形生物。

text: A person with the wings and head of a fly.
translation: 一名具有蒼蠅翅膀與頭部的人形生物。

text: A person with the wings and head of a monarch butterfly.
translation: 一名具有帝王蝶翅膀與頭部的人形生物。

text: A person with the wings and head of a roach.
translation: 一名具有蟑螂翅膀與頭部的人形生物。

text: A person with the wings and head of a snowy owl.
translation: 一名具有雪鴞翅膀與頭部的人形生物。

text: A relatively large arboreal lizard found in the tropical forests.  Though it is a vegetarian, and mainly docile, it may whip with its extremely long tail when angered.
translation: 一種棲息於熱帶森林、體型較大的樹棲蜥蜴。牠以植物為食，通常性情溫順，但發怒時可能甩動極長的尾巴抽打。

text: A relatively large insect found in swamps and marshland.
translation: 一種棲息於沼澤與濕地、體型相對較大的昆蟲。

text: A relatively large lizard.  It can be found in most climates, foraging for bugs during daylight hours.
translation: 一種體型較大的蜥蜴。牠能在多種氣候中生活，白天會四處尋找蟲子吃。

text: A reptile person with the head and tail of a desert tortoise.
translation: 一名爬蟲類、具有沙漠陸龜頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A rolling platform for carrying passengers or cargo.
translation: 一種以車輪移動、用來載運乘客或貨物的平台。
一種野蠻的人形洞穴生物。

text: A serpent made of pure fire which can inject liquid fire as venom.
translation: 一種由純粹火焰構成的蛇，能將液態火焰當作毒液注入獵物體內。

text: A short, sturdy creature fond of drink and industry.
translation: 一種矮小而結實的生物，喜愛飲酒與勞作。

text: A slender, horned man with the head and tail of a impala.
translation: 一種身形纖細、長有角的人形生物，具有黑斑羚的頭部與尾巴。

text: A small aggressive snake which can move very quickly.  Its venom is deadly.
translation: 一種好鬥、移動迅速的小型蛇。牠的毒液足以致命。

text: A small amphibian person with a flat body.
translation: 一名身軀扁平的小型兩棲人。

text: A small amphibian person with the wedge-shaped head and tail of a diplocaulus.
translation: 一名體型嬌小的兩棲類、具有笠頭螈楔形頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A small amphibian with a flat body.
translation: 一種身體扁平的小型兩棲動物。

text: A small animal found in the canopy of the jungle.  They have extremely long arms and legs.
translation: 一種棲息於叢林樹冠的小型動物。牠們有極長的四肢。

text: A small ape found in pairs, swinging from the trees.
translation: 一種成對生活、在樹間擺盪的小型猿類。

text: A small ape found in the trees eating fruit.
translation: 一種生活在樹上、以水果為食的小型猿類。

text: A small ape found in the trees of the tropical forest.  It is known for its calls.
translation: 一種棲息於熱帶森林樹上的小型猿類。牠以叫聲聞名。

text: A small ape from the tropical forest.  It can be found in the trees eating fruit.
translation: 一種來自熱帶森林的小型猿類。牠在樹上以果實為食。

text: A small ape that swings from the trees, eating fruit.
translation: 一種在樹間擺盪、以水果為食的小型猿類。

text: A small aquatic bird, prized for its beauty.
translation: 一種因美麗外貌而受到珍視的小型水鳥。

text: A small arthropod person reminescent of a myriapod.
translation: 一名外形近似多足動物的小型節肢人。

text: A small arthropod person with a broad head.
translation: 一名頭部寬闊的小型節肢人。

text: A small arthropod person with large compound eyes.
translation: 一名長有大型複眼的小型節肢人。

text: A small arthropod person with pronounced eyes and two grasping appendages protruding from their face.
translation: 一名小型節肢人，眼睛突出，臉上伸出一對用於抓握的附肢。

text: A small arthropod person with six spined projections radiating out from its head shield.
translation: 一名小型節肢人，頭盾周圍向外伸出六根帶刺突起。

text: A small arthropod person with the wings of a giant dragonfly.
translation: 一名體型嬌小的節肢類、具有巨型蜻蜓翅膀的人形生物。

text: A small bat-like creature with the head of an insect.  It is found deep underground.
translation: 一種形似蝙蝠、長有昆蟲頭部的小型生物。牠生活在地下深處。

text: A small bird of prey that is capable of great speed.  They dive on unsuspecting vermin.
translation: 一種飛行速度極快的小型猛禽。牠們會俯衝捕捉毫無防備的小動物。

text: A small bird of prey with black markings on its eyes.  It hunts near bodies of water.
translation: 一種眼部帶黑色斑紋的小型猛禽。牠在水域附近狩獵。

text: A small bird with long legs and bill, and a extremely long wingspan.
translation: 一種長腿長喙的小鳥，翼展極長。

text: A small black and white mammal.  It is capable of spraying a stinking fluid.
translation: 一種黑白相間的小型哺乳動物。牠能噴出惡臭液體。

text: A small black bird that feeds on carrion.  It is social, very intelligent and knows how to use tools.
translation: 一種以腐肉為食的黑色小鳥。牠喜歡群居，十分聰明，而且懂得使用工具。

text: A small black bird with bright red markings under the wings.  They live in the marshland.
translation: 一種翼下帶有鮮紅斑紋的黑色小鳥。牠們生活在沼澤地。

text: A small blue and orange bird.
A small blue-crested bird living in temperate woodlands, known for its harsh chirps.
translation: 一種生活在溫帶林地、長有藍色冠羽的小鳥，以刺耳的鳴叫聲聞名。

text: A small bright red bird with a distinctive crest, found in temperate forests.
translation: 一種棲息於溫帶森林的鮮紅小鳥，長有鮮明的冠羽。

text: A small carnivorous animal found in temperate climates.  It has orange fur and is known for its cleverness.
translation: 一種生活在溫帶氣候下的小型肉食動物。牠有橙色毛皮，以機靈聞名。

text: A small cat-like creature found in the jungle.
translation: 一種棲息於叢林的小型貓形生物。

text: A small creature found in both salt and fresh water that lives in an asymmetrical shell rooted to the bottom.
translation: 一種生活在鹹水或淡水中的小型生物，住在固定於水底的不對稱外殼內。

text: A small creature that lives in watery ditches deep underground.  It has a sharp beak and four tentacles with claws at the end.
translation: 一種生活在地下深處水溝中的小型生物。牠有銳利的喙與四條末端帶爪的觸手。

text: A small dinosaur person with a bony head crest.
translation: 一名長有骨質頭冠的小型恐龍人。

text: A small dinosaur person with a long tail and short arms.
translation: 一名長尾短臂的小型恐龍人。

text: A small dinosaur person with a thick domed head.
translation: 一名頭部厚實且呈圓頂狀的小型恐龍人。

text: A small dog-like creature.  They are known to attack livestock.
translation: 一種形似犬的小型生物。牠們會襲擊家畜。

text: A small domestic bird capable of flying short distances.  It is prized for its tasty eggs.
translation: 一種能短距離飛行的小型家禽。牠的蛋十分美味，備受珍視。

text: A small feathered bipedal dinosaur with a beak.
translation: 一種覆有羽毛、長有喙的小型雙足恐龍。

text: A small feathered bipedal dinosaur with a sharp scything claw on its second toe.  It can run very quickly.
translation: 一種覆有羽毛的小型雙足恐龍，第二趾長有銳利的鐮刀狀爪。牠跑得非常快。

text: A small feathered dinosaur person with a beak.
translation: 一名覆有羽毛、長有喙的小型恐龍人。

text: A small feathered dinosaur person with a beaked mouth.
translation: 一名覆有羽毛、長有喙狀嘴的小型恐龍人。

text: A small feathered dinosaur person with a sharp claw on their second toe.
translation: 一名覆有羽毛的小型恐龍人，第二趾上長有利爪。

text: A small feathered dinosaur person with a sharp claw on their second toe.  They can run very quickly.
translation: 一名覆有羽毛的小型恐龍人，第二趾上長有利爪。牠們奔跑得非常快。

text: A small feathered dinosaur person with a single claw on each arm.
translation: 一名覆有羽毛的小型恐龍人，每條手臂上各長有一隻爪。

text: A small feathered dinosaur person with wings.
translation: 一名覆有羽毛、長有翅膀的小型恐龍人。

text: A small feline predator with a shortened tail.
translation: 一種短尾的小型貓科掠食動物。

text: A small fish which can walk on the land and breathe air.  It burrows in the mud when things get dry.
translation: 一種能在陸地上行走並呼吸空氣的小魚。環境乾燥時，牠會鑽進泥裡。

text: A small five-eyed arthropod person with grasping proboscis.
translation: 一名長有五隻眼睛與抓握長吻的小型節肢人。

text: A small flat fish found in the muddy bottom of coastal run-offs and ponds.
translation: 一種小型扁平魚類，棲息於沿海逕流水域與池塘的泥底。

text: A small flat fish found on the muddy bottom of shallow seas.
translation: 一種棲息於淺海泥底的小型扁平魚類。

text: A small flightless bird person with a large beak.
translation: 一名不會飛行、長有大喙的小型鳥人。

text: A small flightless bird that lives on arctic shorelines.
translation: 一種生活在極地海岸、不會飛行的小鳥。

text: A small flightless bird with a large beak.
translation: 一種不會飛行、長有大喙的小鳥。

text: A small flightless bird, blue in color, that lives on arctic shorelines.
translation: 一種生活在極地海岸、體色藍且不會飛行的小鳥。

text: A small flightless bird, it is the largest of the natural penguins.  It is known for its treks through leagues of glacial ice.
translation: 一種小型不會飛的鳥，是天然企鵝中體型最大的。牠以穿越綿延冰川的長途跋涉聞名。

text: A small flightless green parrot.  It is nocturnal and counts itself among the longest-lived birds.
translation: 一種小型、不會飛的綠色鸚鵡。牠在夜間活動，是壽命最長的鳥類之一。

text: A small flying insect that lives in large colonies.  It has a powerful stinger on its tail.  Its hives are prized for their honey.
translation: 一種大群聚居的小型飛蟲。牠尾端的螫針威力強大。牠的巢因能產蜜而備受珍視。

text: A small forest bird known for the distinctive flaps of skin hanging from its face.  It is prized for its meat.
translation: 一種森林小鳥，以臉上垂掛的獨特肉垂聞名。牠的肉備受珍視。

text: A small forest bird.  The male's tail creates an extravagant display for females.  At night, they roost in the trees.
translation: 一種森林小鳥。雄性會展開華麗的尾羽向雌性炫耀。夜晚牠們在樹上棲息。

text: A small four-eyed fish person with a pronounced back fin.
translation: 一名長有四隻眼睛與顯眼背鰭的小型魚人。

text: A small four-finned fish suited to short excursions ashore.
translation: 一種長有四隻鰭、能短暫上岸的小魚。

text: A small fruit-eating ape, found in the trees.
translation: 一種生活在樹上、以水果為食的小型猿類。

text: A small gregarious bird, blue and black with yellow eyes, found in temperate pastures.
translation: 一種棲息於溫帶牧草地的群居小鳥，羽毛藍黑相間，眼睛呈黃色。

text: A small grey rodent found chirping in the trees of temperate woodlands.
translation: 一種小型灰色齧齒動物，會在溫帶林地的樹上吱吱叫。

text: A small ground-dwelling bird.  It has a featherless head and eats seeds and insects.  It moves about in groups.
translation: 一種地棲小鳥。牠頭部無羽，以種子與昆蟲為食，成群活動。

text: A small hooved creature found in large groups in the grasslands.  It has short horns and moves by leaps and bounds.
translation: 一種在草原上成大群生活的小型有蹄生物。牠長有短角，以跳躍方式移動。

text: A small horned mammal.  It can be found in the mountains leaping from rock to rock.
translation: 一種長角的小型哺乳動物。牠在山地的岩石之間跳躍。

text: A small horse person with three fingers and three toes.
translation: 一名每隻手有三指、每隻腳有三趾的小型馬人。

text: A small horse with three toes on each foot.
translation: 一種每隻腳都有三趾的小型馬類。

text: A small humanoid creature with a mischievous, toothy grin.
translation: 一種露出頑皮齒笑的小型人形生物。

text: A small humanoid resembling a walking mushroom with arms and legs.  It lives far underground near water and soil.
translation: 一種形似會走路的蘑菇、長有手腳的小型人形生物。牠生活在地下深處靠近水與土壤的地方。

text: A small humanoid surrounded by fire which they can hurl at their enemies.
translation: 一種被火焰包圍的小型人形生物，能將火焰擲向敵人。

text: A small insect that seeks out unwatched food and garbage.  They fear light.
translation: 一種會尋找無人看管的食物與垃圾的小昆蟲。牠們怕光。

text: A small insect with large orange wings.  It is admired for its beauty.
translation: 一種長有大型橙色翅膀的小昆蟲。牠的美麗令人讚賞。

text: A small lagomorph with long ears.  It has powerful hind legs which it uses to swiftly avoid predators.  It can be found anywhere from forests to deserts.
translation: 一種長耳的小型兔形目動物。牠用強健的後腿迅速躲避掠食者，從森林到沙漠都能見到牠。

text: A small legless person with two eyestalks and a grasping appendage attached to their face.
translation: 一名無腿的小型人形生物，長有兩根眼柄，臉上有用於抓握的附肢。

text: A small limbless reptile known for its deadly venom and the warning of its hood.
translation: 一種無肢的小型爬蟲，以致命毒液與展開頸罩示警聞名。

text: A small lizard with adhesive feet for climbing.  It can change color from brown to green to fit its surroundings.
translation: 一種腳部具有黏附能力、善於攀爬的小蜥蜴。牠能將體色由棕色變為綠色，以融入周圍環境。

text: A small mammal covered in hard scales.  It has a long nose and tongue which it uses to feed.
translation: 一種全身覆有硬鱗的小型哺乳動物。牠利用長鼻與長舌覓食。

text: A small mammal known to defend itself ferociously in combat, often fighting off multiple animals many times its size.
translation: 一種以凶猛自衛聞名的小型哺乳動物，常能擊退多隻體型數倍於自己的動物。

text: A small mammal noted for its tenacity.  It has long ears and flashing eyes.
translation: 一種以頑強聞名的小型哺乳動物。牠有長耳與炯炯有神的眼睛。

text: A small mammal resembling a large, white rat.
translation: 一種外形如大型白鼠的小型哺乳動物。

text: A small mammal with a leathery hide.  It can roll into a ball to escape predators.
translation: 一種皮膚堅韌如革的小型哺乳動物。牠能蜷成一團，躲避掠食者。

text: A small mammal with a striped face.  It lives in groups and is ferocious in combat.
translation: 一種臉部帶條紋的小型哺乳動物。牠們成群生活，打鬥時十分凶猛。

text: A small mammalian carnivore.  It is usually domestic and hunts vermin.
translation: 一種小型肉食哺乳動物。牠通常由人飼養，會獵捕小動物。

text: A small marine creature that lives in a shell rooted to the sea floor.
translation: 一種小型海洋生物，住在固定於海床的外殼內。

text: A small marine fish that travels to rivers to breed.
translation: 一種會游入河流繁殖的小型海魚。

text: A small marine mammal with a long body.  They enjoy eating shellfish and other small animals.
translation: 一種身體細長的小型海洋哺乳動物。牠們喜歡吃貝類與其他小動物。

text: A small marine mammal.  Its young are prized for their white fur.
translation: 一種小型海洋哺乳動物。牠的幼獸因白色毛皮而備受珍視。

text: A small migratory bird.  It has a very long neck and can be found in lakes and other bodies of water.
translation: 一種小型候鳥。牠有很長的頸部，棲息於湖泊與其他水域。

text: A small monkey that can be found in forests and the streets of towns.
translation: 一種出沒於森林與城鎮街道的小猴。
一種棲息於泥中的小型兩棲動物。

text: A small myriapod, though very large for a myriapod.  It feeds on detritus.
translation: 一種小型多足動物，但以多足動物而言體型很大。牠以有機碎屑為食。

text: A small oceanic eel-like creature that latches onto the side of its victim and tears into them.
translation: 一種小型海洋鰻形生物，會附著在受害者身側並撕咬其血肉。

text: A small omnivorous animal with a bright mask of fur.  It is nocturnal and found in temperate forests.  It is a curious animal and has been known to steal from civilized areas.
translation: 一種臉上有鮮明面罩狀毛紋的小型雜食動物。牠在夜間活動，棲息於溫帶森林。牠好奇心旺盛，會到文明聚居地偷東西。

text: A small orange monkey with a long tail.
A small pale creature found in underground streams and ponds.
translation: 一種棲息於地下溪流與池塘的小型蒼白生物。

text: A small person somewhat like a fish and somewhat like an amphibian.
translation: 一名外形介於魚類與兩棲動物之間的小型人形生物。

text: A small person with a head bearing ten tentacles.
translation: 一名頭上長有十條觸手的小型人形生物。

text: A small person with the back spines of a hallucigenia.
translation: 一名體型嬌小、具有怪誕蟲背部尖刺的人形生物。

text: A small person with the head and tail of a mongoose.
translation: 一名體型嬌小、具有獴頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A small person with the head and wings of a crow.
translation: 一名體型嬌小、具有烏鴉頭部與翅膀的人形生物。

text: A small person with the large head, round tummy, and tail of an eryops.
translation: 一名體型嬌小、具有引螈大頭、圓肚與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A small person with the segmented body and antennae of a trilobite.
translation: 一名體型嬌小、具有三葉蟲分節身軀與觸角的人形生物。

text: A small red rodent found in the trees of temperate woodlands.
translation: 一種棲息於溫帶林地樹上的小型紅色齧齒動物。

text: A small reptile person with a gliding membrance between their legs.  They also have wings.
translation: 一名腿間長有滑翔膜的小型爬蟲人。牠們也長有翅膀。

text: A small reptile person with a prehensile tail and giant claws on their second foredigits.
translation: 一名小型爬蟲人，尾巴能夠抓握，前肢的第二指上長有巨大利爪。

text: A small reptile person with a wide two-part carapace.
translation: 一名覆有寬大雙瓣甲殼的小型爬蟲人。

text: A small reptile with a tell-tale rattle and vicious bite that leads to a quick death.
translation: 一種尾部會發出警示響聲的小型爬蟲，凶狠的咬擊可使獵物迅速死亡。

text: A small river mammal with a flat tail, known for building wooden dams.
translation: 一種長有扁尾的小型河棲哺乳動物，以建造木壩聞名。

text: A small river mammal with a long body.  They enjoy eating shellfish and other small animals.
translation: 一種身體細長的小型河川哺乳動物。牠們喜歡吃貝類與其他小動物。

text: A small rock-eating creature that lives in molten rock.  It scurries on little feet and swims through liquid rock with sharp wings.  It uses magma to digest rock and spits out burning globs.
translation: 一種生活在熔岩中、以岩石為食的小型生物。牠用小腳疾走，以銳利的翅膀在液態岩石中游動。牠利用岩漿消化岩石，並吐出燃燒的團塊。

text: A small rodent covered with sharp quills.  They eat grass and leaves and can even climb trees.
translation: 一種覆有尖刺的小型囓齒動物。牠們吃草與葉子，甚至能爬樹。

text: A small rodent with no tail.  It can be found roaming the grassland in herds.  It has three toes on its hind feet.
translation: 一種沒有尾巴的小型囓齒動物。牠們成群在草原上遊蕩，後腳各有三趾。

text: A small round mammal whose back is covered in spines.  It is nocturnal and feeds on insects.  It curls into a ball when startled and is found in temperate regions.
translation: 一種體型圓小、背部覆滿尖刺的哺乳動物。牠在夜間活動，以昆蟲為食。牠受驚時會蜷成一團，棲息於溫帶地區。

text: A small salamander found in remote lakes.  It has the mysterious ability to regrow limbs.
translation: 一種棲息於偏遠湖泊的小型蠑螈。牠具有使斷肢再生的神祕能力。

text: A small sea bird with great wings.  It soars through the sky and dives for food on the surface of the water.
translation: 一種長有巨大雙翼的小型海鳥。牠在天空翱翔，俯衝捕捉水面上的食物。

text: A small semi-aquatic, egg laying mammal with a bill, flat tail and poison spurs.
translation: 一種半水生、會產卵的小型哺乳動物，長有喙、扁尾與毒距。

text: A small slender legless amphibious person.
translation: 一名體形纖細、沒有腿的小型兩棲人。

text: A small snake found in the trees.  It kills its prey by using its long body to constrict them.
translation: 一種棲息於樹上的小型蛇。牠用修長的身體纏繞勒死獵物。

text: A small spiny mammal with a long snout.  It eats ants and termites and reproduces by laying eggs.
translation: 一種長有長吻與尖刺的小型哺乳動物。牠吃螞蟻與白蟻，以產卵方式繁殖。

text: A small spotted fish found in tropical rivers and lakes.
translation: 一種棲息於熱帶河流與湖泊、帶有斑點的小魚。

text: A small striped fish found in fresh water.
translation: 一種帶有條紋的淡水小魚。
一名身有條紋的小型哺乳類人形生物。

text: A small striped mammal predator that hunts a night.  It can open its jaws unusually wide.
translation: 一種帶條紋、夜間狩獵的小型掠食哺乳動物。牠的嘴能張得異常寬大。

text: A small tree-dwelling mammal with distinctive color.  It rears up on its hind legs when cornered.  It uses its front paws like hands.
translation: 一種體色獨特的小型樹棲哺乳動物。牠被逼入絕境時會用後腿站起，並像使用雙手一樣運用前掌。

text: A small underground monster that crawls across the cavern wall with its four clawed hands.  It has a single large eye which can shine with its own light, otherwise its stony skin blends in with the rock.  It has no mouth and is said to feed on evil alone.
translation: 一種以四隻帶爪的手沿洞壁爬行的小型地下怪物。牠有一隻能自行發光的大眼睛；除此之外，石質皮膚能融入岩壁。牠沒有嘴，據說只靠邪惡維生。

text: A small water bird found in remote lakes.  It is known for its haunting call.
translation: 一種棲息於偏遠湖泊的小型水鳥。牠以縈繞不散的叫聲聞名。

text: A small water bird.  It has a long neck and powerful legs meant for swimming and diving.
translation: 一種小型水鳥。牠有長頸與適合游泳、潛水的強健雙腿。

text: A small weasel-like creature that hunts rodents and preys on the nests of birds.
translation: 一種小型鼬形生物，會獵捕齧齒動物並掠食鳥巢中的獵物。

text: A small whiskered fish found in inland waters.
translation: 一種棲息於內陸水域、長有鬚的小魚。

text: A small whiskered fish found in muddy inland waters.
translation: 一種棲息於混濁內陸水域、長有鬚的小魚。

text: A small whiskered fish found scavenging in inland waters.
translation: 一種在內陸水域食腐、長有鬚的小魚。

text: A small white bird that hunts in the coldest reaches of the world.
translation: 一種在世界最寒冷地區獵食的白色小鳥。

text: A small winged fish found in shallow seas.
translation: 一種棲息於淺海、長有翼狀鰭的小魚。

text: A small winged reptile person with a ferocious jaw.
translation: 一名長有翅膀、顎部強勁的小型爬蟲人。

text: A small winged reptile person with a long narrow mouth.
translation: 一名長有翅膀、嘴部狹長的小型爬蟲人。

text: A small winged reptile person with a round head.
translation: 一名長有翅膀、頭部圓潤的小型爬蟲人。

text: A small wolf-like scavenger.  Normally found in pairs, jackals can form packs when they find a body.
translation: 一種形似狼的小型食腐動物。胡狼通常成對活動，但找到屍體時也會聚集成群。

text: A small woolly insect that lives in hive colonies.  It has an annoying sting which it rarely uses.
translation: 一種在巢中群居、覆有絨毛的小昆蟲。牠的螫刺令人難受，但很少使用。

text: A small yellow and black bird.  They feed in the canopy of the forest.
translation: 一種黃黑相間的小鳥。牠們在森林樹冠間覓食。

text: A small, brightly-colored snake.  It is known for eating other snakes and being mistaken for its venomous cousins.
translation: 一種體色鮮豔的小型蛇。牠以捕食其他蛇聞名，也常被誤認為有毒的近親。

text: A small, brown, flightless bird.  It eats insects and grubs and is known for its keen sense of smell.
translation: 一種棕色、不會飛的小鳥。牠吃昆蟲與幼蟲，以敏銳的嗅覺聞名。
一種體色鮮豔、不會飛行的小鳥。

text: A small, foreboding black bird that feeds on carrion.  It is social, very intelligent, and knows how to use tools.
translation: 一種令人不安、以腐肉為食的黑色小鳥。牠喜歡群居，十分聰明，而且懂得使用工具。

text: A small, green, intelligent mountain parrot.
translation: 一種綠色、聰明的小型山地鸚鵡。
一種灰色的樹棲小型生物。

text: A small, intelligent vermin with a long naked tail.
translation: 一種聰明的小型害獸，長有裸露的長尾。

text: A small, jawless, filter-feeding fish found in brooks and streams.
translation: 一種棲息於小溪中的小型無顎濾食魚類。

text: A small, long-armed ape.  It lives in trees and eats fruit.
translation: 一種長臂的小型猿類。牠生活在樹上，以果實為食。
一種長鼻的小型浣熊形生物。

text: A small, muscular, weasel-like creature.  It is known for its ferocity.
translation: 一種體格強健、形似鼬的小型生物。牠以凶猛聞名。

text: A small, nocturnal bird of prey found in woodland regions.  Its hunger for rodents drives it to take residence in buildings.
translation: 一種棲息於林地、夜間活動的小型猛禽。牠對囓齒動物的食慾促使牠住進建築物中。

text: A small, nocturnal bird of prey with large eyes and protruding feathers.
translation: 一種夜行性小型猛禽，長有大眼與突出的羽毛。

text: A small, nocturnal mammal.  It has a long tongue with which to eat insects.
translation: 一種夜間活動的小型哺乳動物。牠用長舌捕食昆蟲。

text: A small, nocturnal, marine fish.  It can be found hunting in coral reefs.
translation: 一種夜間活動的小型海魚。牠在珊瑚礁中獵食。

text: A small, nocturnal, tree-dwelling mammal.  It uses its long fingers to fish out grubs from the wood.
translation: 一種夜間活動的小型樹棲哺乳動物。牠用長手指從木頭中掏出幼蟲。

text: A small, pale arthropod found in underground streams and ponds.
translation: 一種棲息於地下溪流與池塘、體色蒼白的小型節肢動物。

text: A small, predatory, weasel-like mammal.  It is also semi-aquatic.
translation: 一種形似鼬的小型掠食哺乳動物。牠也過著半水生生活。

text: A small, round humanoid found wandering the caves deep underground.  Most of its body is taken up by a huge tusked mouth.
translation: 一種在地下深處洞穴遊蕩、體型圓小的人形生物。長有獠牙的巨口占據了牠身體的大部分。

text: A small, round, brightly-colored fish found in coral reefs.
translation: 一種棲息於珊瑚礁、身形圓潤且體色鮮豔的小魚。

text: A small, shark-like creature that lives in the ocean's muddy shallows.  Its skin sparkles and it has a venomous spine on its back.
translation: 一種生活在海洋泥濘淺水區、形似鯊魚的小型生物。牠的皮膚閃閃發光，背上長有毒棘。
一種身形纖細的小型瞪羚形生物。

text: A small, slow-moving mammal that lives in the trees.
translation: 一種生活在樹上、行動緩慢的小型哺乳動物。

text: A small, spineless, eel-like fish that lives on the bottom of the ocean.  It can turn the water around its body into a cloud of slime to escape predators.
translation: 一種生活在海底、形似鰻魚且沒有脊椎的小魚。牠能讓身體周圍的水變成一團黏液，以躲避掠食者。

text: A small, squat humanoid with large pointy ears and yellow glowing eyes.
translation: 一種矮胖的小型人形生物，長有大尖耳，眼睛閃著黃光。

text: A small, stocky mammal.  It is found from the mountains to the woodlands.
translation: 一種矮壯的小型哺乳動物。從山地到林地都能見到牠。

text: A snake-like creature living deep underground.  Its head is covered in armor so that is resembles the head of a dragon.
translation: 一種生活在地下深處的蛇形生物。牠的頭部覆有甲片，看起來像龍的頭。

text: A spiny person with the head of an echidna.
translation: 一名渾身帶刺、具有針鼴頭部的人形生物。

text: A spotted person with the head and tail of a cheetah.
translation: 一名身有斑點、具有獵豹頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A spotted person with the head and tail of a jaguar.
translation: 一名身有斑點、具有美洲豹頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A spotted person with the head and tail of a leopard.
translation: 一名身有斑點、具有花豹頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A squat amphibian with leathery skin, found in relatively dry areas.
translation: 一種皮膚堅韌如革、身形矮胖的兩棲動物，棲息於較乾燥的地區。

text: A strange crystalline creature the shape of a man.  It is found deep underground.
translation: 一種人形的奇異結晶生物。牠生活在地下深處。

text: A strange shapeless life form with an orange leathery skin containing a liquid interior.  It can secrete its internal fluid.
translation: 一種沒有固定形狀的奇異生命體，橙色革質外皮包裹著液態的內部。牠能分泌體內的液體。

text: A striped person with the head and tail of a chipmunk.
translation: 一名身有條紋、具有花栗鼠頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A striped person with the head and tail of a skunk.
translation: 一名身有條紋、具有臭鼬頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A swift, long-eared rodent with long legs and a short fluffy tail.
translation: 一種動作敏捷的長耳囓齒動物，長有長腿與蓬鬆短尾。

text: A tiny amphibian that lives in the trees.
translation: 一種生活在樹上的微小兩棲動物。

text: A tiny amphibian with a long prehensile tail.  It lives in underground swamps and tower-cap forests on which it feeds.
translation: 一種長有可抓握長尾的微小兩棲動物。牠生活在地下沼澤與高塔菌林中，並以高塔菌為食。

text: A tiny amphibian, found in underground streams.
translation: 一種棲息於地下溪流的微小兩棲動物。

text: A tiny amphibious limbless vertebrate that feeds on creatures as it slithers about.
translation: 一種微小的無肢兩棲脊椎動物，一邊蜿蜒爬行一邊捕食其他生物。

text: A tiny aquatic arthropod with a broad head and tapering body.
translation: 一種微小的水生節肢動物，頭部寬闊，身體向尾端漸細。

text: A tiny aquatic arthropod with pronounced eyes and two frontal grasping appendages.
translation: 一種微小的水生節肢動物，眼睛突出，前端長有一對抓握附肢。

text: A tiny aquatic worm-like creature with ten pairs slender legs and seven pairs of protruding rigid spines along its body.
translation: 一種微小的水生蠕蟲形生物，長有十對細腿，體側伸出七對硬刺。

text: A tiny arthropod person with the protective spines of a wiwaxia.
translation: 一名體型微小的節肢類、具有威瓦克蟲防禦棘刺的人形生物。

text: A tiny arthropod that walks tilted upright on two large legs.  Six spined projections radiate outward from its head shield.
translation: 一種用兩條大腿傾斜直立行走的微小節肢動物。六根帶刺的突起從頭甲向外放射伸出。

text: A tiny bipedal dinosaur.  It runs along the ground and eats small prey.
translation: 一種微小的雙足恐龍。牠在地面奔跑，捕食小型獵物。

text: A tiny bird of prey.  It hovers above the ground and swoops down to snatch rodents and mice.
translation: 一種微小的猛禽。牠在地面上方懸停，再俯衝下去捕捉囓齒動物與老鼠。

text: A tiny bird with a large, brightly-colored bill.
translation: 一種長有鮮豔大喙的微小鳥類。

text: A tiny black and white bird.  It is one of the most intelligent of the natural creatures.
translation: 一種黑白相間的微小鳥類。牠是天然生物中最聰明的物種之一。

text: A tiny black bug that lacks a web but can leap short distances.
translation: 一種不會結網、卻能短距離跳躍的微小黑色蟲類。

text: A tiny blue-green oceanic fish, found only in temperate waters.
translation: 一種僅棲息於溫帶水域的微小藍綠色海魚。

text: A tiny brown bird found in open woodlands.
translation: 一種棲息於開闊林地的微小棕色鳥類。

text: A tiny brown bird given to singing complex songs.
translation: 一種善於唱出複雜歌聲的微小棕色鳥類。

text: A tiny brown bird that can be found in most temperate regions.
translation: 一種常見於大多數溫帶地區的微小棕色鳥類。

text: A tiny brown bug known for its powerful poison.
translation: 一種以劇毒聞名的微小棕色蟲類。

text: A tiny burrowing creature, found in moist soil.  It is legless, long and thin.
translation: 一種棲息於潮濕土壤、會鑽洞的微小生物。牠沒有腿，身體細長。

text: A tiny colorful fish found in tropical lakes and rivers.
translation: 一種棲息於熱帶湖泊與河流、體色鮮豔的微小魚類。

text: A tiny creature made up of a series of crackling knobs set at strange angles.
translation: 一種微小生物，由一連串角度奇異、劈啪作響的節塊組成。

text: A tiny crested parrot.  They are prized as domestic companions.
translation: 一種微小的冠羽鸚鵡。牠們作為家庭伴侶備受珍視。

text: A tiny diurnal monkey.  It spends its time in the trees searching for food.
translation: 一種白天活動的微小猴類。牠在樹間度日，四處尋找食物。

text: A tiny diving bird found living on seaside cliffs in the colder climates.
translation: 一種生活在寒冷地區海邊峭壁上的微小潛水鳥類。

text: A tiny feathered bipedal dinosaur with a single claw on each side of its upper body.
translation: 一種覆有羽毛的微小雙足恐龍，上半身兩側各長有一隻爪。

text: A tiny feathered dinosaur with wings capable of flight.
translation: 一種覆有羽毛的微小恐龍，長有能夠飛行的翅膀。

text: A tiny five-eyed aquatic arthropod with a grasping proboscis.
translation: 一種微小的水生節肢動物，長有五隻眼睛與用來抓握的長吻。

text: A tiny flying insect found around rotting meat and garbage.  These bugs are widely considered to be a nuisance.
translation: 一種出沒於腐肉與垃圾周圍的微小飛蟲。這些蟲子普遍被視為惱人的害蟲。

text: A tiny flying insect that can be seen at night by its glowing tail.
translation: 一種尾部發光的微小飛蟲，夜間可以看見牠的光芒。

text: A tiny flying reptile with a small round head.
translation: 一種頭部小而圓的微小飛行爬蟲。

text: A tiny four-eyed fish with a pronounced fin along its back.
translation: 一種長有四隻眼睛與顯眼背鰭的微小魚類。

text: A tiny furry rodent dwelling in the hollow cracks of rocks.  They can be found high in the mountains.
translation: 一種覆有毛皮、住在岩縫中的微小囓齒動物。牠們棲息於高山。

text: A tiny green insect.  It has long, distinctive forelimbs that it uses to catch its prey.
translation: 一種微小的綠色昆蟲。牠用獨特的修長前肢捕捉獵物。

text: A tiny grey rodent that is only active at night.  It can sail between trees on wings stretching between its front and hind legs.
translation: 一種只在夜間活動的微小灰色囓齒動物。牠能利用前後腿之間展開的翼膜，在樹木之間滑翔。

text: A tiny hemispherical arthropod with protective spines.
translation: 一種身形呈半球狀、長有防禦棘刺的微小節肢動物。

text: A tiny insect capable of destroying large wooden structures when in large numbers.
translation: 一種微小昆蟲，聚集大量個體時足以摧毀大型木構建築。

text: A tiny insect that can be found almost anywhere outside.
translation: 一種幾乎遍布所有戶外地區的微小昆蟲。

text: A tiny insect which uses its powerful legs to leap and make noise.
translation: 一種用強勁後腿跳躍與發聲的微小昆蟲。

text: A tiny insect with a pulsating, lumpy body.  It is an evil bug that seeks blood.
translation: 一種身體凹凸不平、不斷搏動的微小昆蟲。牠是尋求鮮血的邪惡蟲子。

text: A tiny land mollusk with a large shell.
translation: 一種背負大殼的微小陸生軟體動物。

text: A tiny land mollusk.  It can be found under rotten logs and in gardens.
translation: 一種微小的陸生軟體動物。牠棲息於腐木底下與花園中。

text: A tiny larva which is prized for its milk.
translation: 一種因所產乳汁而受到珍視的微小幼蟲。

text: A tiny mammal with a slender body.  It hunts in mouse holes as well as barn yards.
translation: 一種身體纖細的微小哺乳動物。牠會在鼠洞與穀倉庭院中狩獵。

text: A tiny marine fish found in vast schools.
translation: 一種聚集成龐大魚群的微小海魚。

text: A tiny nocturnal insect.  It flies toward flames in the night.
translation: 一種夜間活動的微小昆蟲。牠會在夜裡飛向火焰。

text: A tiny orange marine fish that lives inside the tentacles of a poisonous invertebrate.
translation: 一種微小的橙色海魚，生活在有毒無脊椎動物的觸手之間。

text: A tiny orange-striped fish.  It lives in inland waters.
translation: 一種帶橙色條紋的微小魚類。牠生活在內陸水域。

text: A tiny parasitic insect.  It feeds on skin and blood.
translation: 一種微小的寄生昆蟲。牠以皮膚與血液為食。

text: A tiny parrot found in flocks of many hundreds.  Exceptional birds can be taught to speak.
translation: 一種數百隻聚集成群的微小鸚鵡。特別出色的個體能學會說話。

text: A tiny pest insect.  It feeds on both crops and other bugs.
translation: 一種微小的害蟲。牠既吃農作物，也吃其他蟲子。

text: A tiny pest insect.  It uses its long nose to suck blood from its host.
translation: 一種微小的害蟲。牠用長長的口器吸取宿主的血液。

text: A tiny predatory mollusk.  It is brightly colored.
translation: 一種微小的掠食軟體動物。牠色彩鮮豔。

text: A tiny reptile with a gliding membrane between its back legs.
translation: 一種後腿間長有滑翔膜的微小爬蟲。

text: A tiny reptile with a shell on its back.  It can be found in rivers and ponds.
translation: 一種背上有殼的微小爬行動物。牠棲息於河流與池塘。

text: A tiny reptile, running on two legs.  It has a horn on the end of its nose.
translation: 一種用兩條腿奔跑的微小爬行動物。牠的鼻端長有一隻角。

text: A tiny rodent that burrows by day and scurries about at night.
translation: 一種白天掘穴、夜間四處奔竄的微小齧齒動物。

text: A tiny scuttling arthropod with large compound eyes.
translation: 一種長有大型複眼、快速爬行的微小節肢動物。

text: A tiny sea animal that lives in the sand just offshore.  It has a flat body with legs underneath.
translation: 一種生活在近岸沙地中的微小海洋動物。牠身體扁平，腿長在身體下方。

text: A tiny sea creature which dwells on the ocean floor, devoid of senses or motion.
translation: 一種棲息於海床的微小海洋生物，沒有感官，也無法移動。

text: A tiny sea mollusk.  It can change color and skin patterns for communication.
translation: 一種微小的海洋軟體動物。牠能改變體色與皮膚花紋來溝通。

text: A tiny sea vermin with eight arms and two tentacles.  It can spray ink to confuse predators.
translation: 一種長有八條腕足與兩條觸手的微小海洋生物。牠能噴出墨汁迷惑掠食者。

text: A tiny shelled ocean creature with many long legs.  It has two large pincers on its front limbs.
translation: 一種有殼的微小海洋生物，長有許多長腿。牠的前肢上有兩隻大螯。

text: A tiny shelled reptile that lives in the desert.
translation: 一種背負硬殼、生活在沙漠的微小爬蟲。

text: A tiny snake with ridged scales and a powerful venomous bite.
translation: 一種鱗片帶有稜脊的微小蛇類，咬擊含有強烈毒液。

text: A tiny soft-bodied aquatic creature with a grasping forward appendage, two eyestalks and a finned tail.
translation: 一種微小的軟體水生生物，前端有抓握附肢，長有兩根眼柄與帶鰭的尾巴。

text: A tiny spotted fish found in coastal rivers and temperate lakes.
translation: 一種棲息於沿海河流及溫帶湖泊、帶有斑點的微小魚類。

text: A tiny striped rodent found scurrying through the bushes and trees of the temperate forest.
translation: 一種微小的條紋齧齒動物，在溫帶森林的灌木與樹木間穿梭。

text: A tiny translucent creature, found in evil forests.
translation: 一種棲息於邪惡森林的微小半透明生物。

text: A tiny underground bug, sought after for its thread.
translation: 一種因所產絲線而受到追捧的微小地下蟲類。

text: A tiny underground creature made of a mass of appendages resembling human fingers.  It creeps across the ground like a starfish and eats with a mouth on the bottom of its body.
translation: 一種由大量形似人類手指的附肢構成的微小地下生物。牠像海星般在地上爬行，用身體底部的嘴進食。

text: A tiny underground monster with large claws and horns.  It walks on two legs and is dangerous when encountered in large numbers.
translation: 一種長有大爪與角的微小地下怪物。牠用兩條腿行走，大量出現時十分危險。

text: A tiny venomous snake found in the woods and swamps.
translation: 一種棲息於林地與沼澤的微小毒蛇。

text: A tiny venomous snake.  It is the longest of the pit vipers.
translation: 一種微小的毒蛇。牠是蝮蛇中身體最長的。

text: A tiny winged creature that hunts at night and rests in caves during the day.
translation: 一種有翼的微小生物，夜間獵食，白天在洞穴休息。

text: A tiny winged humanoid with shifting colors which performs intricate aerial dances in large groups.
translation: 一種有翼的微小人形生物，體色不斷變幻，會成群在空中跳出複雜的舞蹈。

text: A tiny winged insect, though exceptionally large for a dragonfly.
translation: 一種微小的有翼昆蟲，但以蜻蜓而言卻格外龐大。

text: A tiny yellow bug.  It has pincers and a stinging tail which can prove fatal.
translation: 一種微小的黃色蟲子。牠長有鉗子與帶螫針的尾巴，螫刺可能致命。

text: A tiny, aquatic, worm-like creature that feeds on blood.
translation: 一種以血液為食的微小水生蠕蟲形生物。

text: A tiny, blood-sucking bug found in wooded areas.
translation: 一種棲息於林地的微小吸血蟲類。

text: A tiny, brightly colored parrot.  They are clever and learn many tricks.
translation: 一種色彩鮮豔的微小鸚鵡。牠們很聰明，能學會許多把戲。
一種體色鮮豔的微小蜥蜴。

text: A tiny, brightly-colored tree parrot.  It uses its tongue to feed on plants.
translation: 一種色彩鮮豔、棲息於樹上的微小鸚鵡。牠用舌頭攝食植物。

text: A tiny, colorful bird.  It can be trained to be a pleasant companion.
translation: 一種色彩繽紛的微小鳥類。牠能受訓成為討人喜愛的伴侶。
一種身體修長、色彩鮮豔的微小昆蟲。

text: A tiny, curved and colorful fish found in coral reefs.
translation: 一種棲息於珊瑚礁、身軀彎曲且色彩鮮豔的微小魚類。

text: A tiny, foul-tempered humanoid creature that dwells in the evil mountains.  They are known to enjoy drinking liquor and will take any unguarded supplies of booze.
translation: 一種居住在邪惡山地、脾氣暴躁的微小人形生物。牠們喜歡喝酒，會拿走任何無人看管的酒。

text: A tiny, giggling humanoid with lacy wings.
translation: 一種長有蕾絲般翅膀、咯咯發笑的微小人形生物。

text: A tiny, jolly humanoid creature that dwells in the fair mountains.  They are known to enjoy drinking liquor and don't care whether it's theirs or not.
translation: 一種居住在美好山地、性情歡快的微小人形生物。牠們喜歡喝酒，而且不在乎酒是不是自己的。

text: A tiny, mollusk with a large shell and many tentacles.
translation: 一種長有大殼與眾多觸手的微小軟體動物。

text: A towering herbivorous quadrupedal dinosaur with a long neck.
translation: 一種高聳的四足草食恐龍，長有修長的頸部。

text: A transparent and amorphous monster that lives underground.  It is small in size and is found crawling across the cavern floor.  Its organs appear to be floating inside of its body.
translation: 一種生活在地下、透明而沒有固定形狀的怪物。牠體型小，會沿洞穴地面爬行。牠的器官看起來像漂浮在體內。

text: A venomous person with the head and tail of a gila monster.
translation: 一名帶有毒液、具有毒蜥頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: A very large aquatic reptile with fish-like fins and an elongated snout.
translation: 一種非常大的水生爬蟲，長有魚鰭般的肢體與細長吻部。

text: A very large aquatic reptile with four flippers and a long neck.
translation: 一種非常大的水生爬蟲，長有四隻鰭肢與長頸。

text: A very large bipedal dinosaur with a giant biting jaw and a strong flexible neck.
translation: 一種非常大的雙足恐龍，長有巨大的咬合顎部與強壯靈活的頸部。

text: A very large carnivorous bipedal dinosaur with a horn and short arms.
translation: 一種非常大的雙足肉食恐龍，長有一隻角與短小前肢。

text: A very large carnivorous bipedal dinosaur with two parallel head crests and short arms.
translation: 一種非常大的雙足肉食恐龍，頭上有兩道平行冠飾，前肢短小。

text: A very large cephalopod with a coiled shell.
translation: 一種背負螺旋外殼的非常大的頭足動物。

text: A very large dinosaur person with a ferocious jaw, short arms, a sail and a horn.
translation: 一名體型碩大的恐龍人，顎部強勁、手臂短小，長有背帆與一隻角。

text: A very large dinosaur person with a ferocious jaw, short arms, and a sail.
translation: 一名體型碩大的恐龍人，顎部強勁、手臂短小，長有背帆。

text: A very large dinosaur person with a long neck.
translation: 一名長頸、體型碩大的恐龍人。

text: A very large dinosaur person with a mighty jaw and very short arms with two fingers.
translation: 一名體型碩大的恐龍人，顎部強而有力，極短的手臂上各有兩指。

text: A very large dinosaur person with a tail club, an armored carapace and four horns.
translation: 一名體型碩大的恐龍人，長有尾錘、堅硬甲殼與四隻角。

text: A very large dinosaur person with thumb spikes and a beaked mouth.
translation: 一名體型碩大的恐龍人，拇指呈尖刺狀，嘴部呈喙狀。

text: A very large feathered bipedal dinosaur with a sharp scything claw on its second toe.
translation: 一種非常大的有羽雙足恐龍，第二趾上長有鋒利的鐮刀狀爪。

text: A very large feathered dinosaur person with three giant claws on each hand.
translation: 一名體型碩大、覆有羽毛的恐龍人，每隻手上長有三隻巨爪。

text: A very large hairless mammal person with a long neck and a small trunk
translation: 一名體型碩大的無毛哺乳類人形生物，長有長頸與短鼻。

text: A very large hairless mammal person with a trunk and two backward-curving tusks.
translation: 一名體型碩大的無毛哺乳類人形生物，長有長鼻與兩根向後彎曲的獠牙。

text: A very large herbivorous bipedal dinosaur with a thick domed head.
translation: 一種非常大的雙足草食恐龍，頭部厚實且呈圓頂狀。

text: A very large herbivorous quadrupedal dinosaur with a long neck.
translation: 一種非常大的長頸四足草食恐龍。

text: A very large legless person with a giant toothy mouth.
translation: 一名體型碩大、沒有腿的人形生物，巨嘴中長滿牙齒。

text: A very large legless shark person.
translation: 一名體型碩大、沒有腿的鯊魚人。

text: A very large mammalian omnivore with a long head.
translation: 一種頭部狹長、非常大的雜食性哺乳動物。

text: A very large person with a bony head frill and three horns.
translation: 一名體型碩大的人形生物，長有骨質頭盾與三隻角。

text: A very large person with a spiky head frill and three horns.
translation: 一名體型碩大的人形生物，長有帶刺頭盾與三隻角。

text: A very large quadrupedal predator, well-suited to the hunt.  It has a tail and powerful jaws, and it is terrestrial.
translation: 一種非常大型、善於狩獵的四足掠食動物。牠長有尾巴與強健的顎部，在陸地上生活。

text: A very large snake.  It is amphibious and constricts its prey.
translation: 一種非常大型的蛇。牠能在水陸活動，會纏繞勒住獵物。

text: A very large woolly mammal person with two tusks.
translation: 一名體型碩大、覆有厚毛的哺乳類人形生物，長有兩根獠牙。

text: A very small amphibian with a wedge-shaped head and long tail.
translation: 一種非常小的兩棲動物，頭部呈楔形，尾巴修長。

text: A very small aquatic arthropod with two antennae.  It has many legs underneath its flat segmented oval body.  They can curl into a ball to protect themselves.
translation: 一種長有兩根觸角、非常小的水生節肢動物。牠扁平、分節的橢圓身體下方長有許多腿。牠們能蜷成一團保護自己。

text: A very small bipedal dinosaur with a long tail and short arms.  It is omnivorous.
translation: 一種非常小的雙足恐龍，長有長尾與短臂。牠是雜食動物。

text: A very small bipedal herbivorous dinosaur with a bony head crest.
translation: 一種非常小的雙足草食恐龍，長有骨質頭冠。

text: A very small bipedal herbivorous dinosaur with a thick domed head.
translation: 一種非常小的雙足草食恐龍，頭部厚實且呈圓頂狀。

text: A very small feathered bipedal dinosaur with a sharp scything claw on its second toe.
translation: 一種非常小的有羽雙足恐龍，第二趾上長有鋒利的鐮刀狀爪。

text: A very small feathered bipedal dinosaur with a single claw on each side of its upper body.
translation: 一種非常小的有羽雙足恐龍，上半身兩側各長有一隻爪。

text: A very small feathered bipedal dinosaur with an opposable fifth finger.  It is a herbivore and has a beaked mouth.
translation: 一種覆有羽毛、非常小的雙足恐龍，第五指能與其他手指相對抓握。牠以植物為食，嘴部呈喙狀。

text: A very small flying reptile with a long narrow mouth.
translation: 一種嘴部狹長、非常小的飛行爬蟲。

text: A very small flying reptile with long wings and a ferocious jaw.
translation: 一種非常小的飛行爬蟲，長有長翼與強勁顎部。
一種非常小的飛行爬蟲。

text: A very small mammal with short legs and a long tail.  It hunts small animals to eat.
translation: 一種腿短、尾巴長的極小哺乳動物。牠獵捕小動物為食。

text: A very small reptile with a divided carapace.
translation: 一種覆有分瓣甲殼、非常小的爬蟲。

text: A very small reptile with a prehensile tail and giant claws on its second foredigits.
translation: 一種非常小的爬蟲，尾巴能夠抓握，前肢第二指上長有巨爪。

text: A very small squat amphibian with a round tummy and long tail.
translation: 一種非常小而矮胖的兩棲動物，長有圓肚與長尾。

text: A worm-like creature with the torso of a man.
translation: 一種長有人類軀幹的蠕蟲狀生物。

text: An animal person with the head of the amphibious olm.  It lives underground near water.
translation: 一名長有兩棲動物洞螈頭部的人形生物。牠生活在地下的水邊。

text: An aquatic arthropod with a pronounced head structure and frontal appendages for filter feeding.  It is large for an arthropod.
translation: 一種水生節肢動物，有明顯的頭部構造與用於濾食的前方附肢。以節肢動物而言，牠的體型很大。

text: An aquatic arthropod with a wide head and tapering body.
translation: 一種水生節肢動物，頭部寬闊，身體向尾端漸細。

text: An aquatic person in the shape of an orca with arms.
translation: 一名外形如虎鯨、長有手臂的水生人形生物。

text: An arthropod person with the pronounced head shape of an aegirocassis.
translation: 一名節肢類、具有海神盔蝦鮮明頭形的人形生物。

text: An elusive medium-sized fish found in coastal waters.
translation: 一種棲息於沿海水域、難以尋覓的中型魚類。

text: An evil humanoid with a long tail, black spiky fur and a twitching nose.  It lives far underground.
translation: 一種邪惡的人形生物，長有長尾、黑色刺狀毛皮與不斷抽動的鼻子。牠生活在地下深處。

text: An evil monster from the swamp.  It resembles a knot of waterlogged weeds but will strike the unaware victim.
translation: 一種來自沼澤的邪惡怪物。牠看起來像一團浸透水的雜草，卻會襲擊毫無防備的受害者。

text: An insect many times the size of its peers.  It is known for its deafening buzz.
translation: 一種體型是同類許多倍大的昆蟲。牠以震耳欲聾的嗡嗡聲聞名。

text: An insidious form of vermin.  It lives only to steal food from others.
translation: 一種陰險的小型害獸。牠活著只為偷取他人的食物。

text: An invertebrate found off the coast.  It has a sting which can be severe.
translation: 一種棲息於近海的無脊椎動物。牠的螫刺可能造成嚴重傷害。

text: An orange person with the head and tail of a lion tamarin.
translation: 一名通體橙色、具有獅狨猴頭部與尾巴的人形生物。

text: An orange striped person with the head of a tiger.
translation: 一名身有橙色條紋、具有虎頭部的人形生物。

text: Fire in the shape of a human that can hurl fireballs.
translation: 呈人形、能投擲火球的火焰。

text: Living gabbro in the shape of a man.  These strange creatures are found deep underground.
translation: 呈人形的活體輝長岩。這些奇異的生物生活在地下深處。

text: Magma moving in the shape of a man.  It has a cracked black crust.
translation: 以人形移動的岩漿。牠覆有龜裂的黑色外殼。

text: The bookkeeper keeps an accurate count of items in the fortress. They work in their office to improve the precision of the count.
translation: 簿記員負責精確清點要塞中的物品，並在辦公室工作以提高清點結果的精度。

text: The broker uses their appraisal skill to allow you to see the value of items in the fortress. They are also the default negotiator with visiting merchants.
translation: 經紀人運用估價技能，讓你得知要塞內物品的價值。他們也是與來訪商人交涉的預設人選。

text: The chief medical dwarf allows you to see the overall health of dwarves in your fortress.
translation: 首席醫療矮人讓你查看要塞中矮人的整體健康狀況。

text: The largest of the giant cats.  It can be found hunting alone in the most savage countryside.
translation: 巨型貓科動物中體型最大的一種。牠會在最蠻荒的野外獨自狩獵。

text: The manager handles work orders. Once your fortress reaches a certain population, the manager must work in an office to validate work orders.
translation: 管理員負責處理工作訂單。要塞達到一定人口後，管理員必須在辦公室工作，才能核准工作訂單。

text: The most intelligent of birds.  It can be found in the rainforest.
translation: 鳥類中最聰明的一種。牠棲息於雨林。

text: These creatures are shaped like men covered with rough scales.  They have the head and tail of a lizard and possess a dark and evil intelligence.  They are found deep under the earth.
translation: 這些生物形似覆有粗糙鱗片的人類。牠們長有蜥蜴的頭與尾巴，擁有陰暗邪惡的智慧。牠們生活在地下深處。

text: These evil creatures resemble walking frogs with arms and the intelligence to use them.  They live in the waters far under the earth.
translation: 這些邪惡的生物形似會走路的青蛙，長有雙臂，也有運用雙臂的智慧。牠們生活在地下深處的水域。

text: This is a medium-sized creature with legs and arms, but the long neck and head of an ostrich.
translation: 這是一種長有雙腿與雙臂的中型生物，卻有鴕鳥般的長頸與頭部。

text: This tiny insect can be found in huge colonies in the dirt.  They overwhelm their enemies with swarms.  Some have poison bites.
translation: 這種微小的昆蟲會在土中形成龐大的群落。牠們以蜂擁而上的數量壓倒敵人。有些個體咬人帶毒。
